# Approved augmented scarce-data baseline diagnostic

19 September 2026. User explicitly approved exactly three fresh Dice-only
baseline runs, seeds 0/1/2, fold 0, the original ten training case files and
52 validation cases. No bands, cut rule, conditional CE auxiliary or other
constraint training. No extra training preflight or automatic retry is authorized.

## Training

Reuse the immutable long-run training source ab972a098df39cbb874838a6e0009936a7497224db7bdf5c72eb427f3c433940,
not the modified working-tree source. Preserve architecture, original Dice
including background, AdamW 1e-4 / weight decay 1e-5, AMP, batch 1, plain
tensors, no activation checkpointing, dropout zero, validation every epoch.
Use the previously tested mild_v1 single-view augmentation (frozen JSON policy).
Train exactly 200 epochs, StepLR 53 / 0.5, no accuracy-based early stopping.
Count attempted and successful optimizer steps separately. Augmentation RNG is
seed+1, separate from model/data streams as in the existing implementation.

Save best overall validation-Dice and final full checkpoints. Also retain
compact fixed-epoch weights at 75/160/169 and best-through-160/169 weights.
These extra snapshots and optimizer-step counter are implemented by a hashed
orchestration wrapper, not by edits to frozen training source. No snapshot or
audit modifies weights, data order or training RNG. Compact snapshots are not
resume checkpoints. Epoch 75 under this stretched LR schedule is NOT the old
75-epoch trajectory. Existing no-augmentation latest epochs are 160/160/169;
compare matched horizons separately from the new 200-epoch endpoint. Selection
continues to use the reused validation cohort and is exploratory, not a test.

## Diagnostic exports

For all seven checkpoint records, run eval-mode identity inference on clean
training and validation cases, plus eight fixed mild_v1 views per training case.
Diagnostic view seeds are a stable hash of experiment/case/view, identical
across model seeds and checkpoints, independent of training augmentation RNG.
Save transformation sampling metadata, image/label hashes and prediction/GT/
float32 A/P margin caches. Augmented views are repeated observations of ten
training cases, not eighty independent samples or held-out validation subjects.

Report both swap directions, foreground FP/FN, per-class and case-macro Dice,
swaps per true and retained GT foreground, foreground-conditional original-label
A/P CE, and its analytic gradient RMS over all three output-logit channels.
The latter is a diagnostic learning signal, not the proposed cut rule or a
parameter-gradient estimate. Zero hard swaps need not mean zero loss/gradient.
No rule coefficient is calibrated and no constraint is applied in this stage.

Report fitted coronal cut misplacement and MAE on clean inputs. On fixed views
with spatial affine applied, do not mislabel axis-aligned fit error as anatomical
cut error: rotations change the cut orientation. Save the view geometry for a
later transformation-aware audit. Intensity-only/identity views retain coronal
diagnostics. A future cut-location loss must transform its target consistently;
the current implementation does not support mild_v1 with the plane-location
rule. Released-label nonplanar exceptions must not be silently discarded.

Residual training errors motivate but do not prove an auxiliary-loss benefit.
Require validation improvement, stable cut location and no concealed increase
in foreground misses. A later constraint comparison requires separate approval.

## Submission and budget

Exactly three Slurm allocations, A100 MIG 3g.40gb, 6 CPUs, 64 GB, 30 minutes
each, maximum 90 allocated slice-minutes including export diagnostics. This
is a hard allowance, not measured runtime for this augmented ten-case setting.
If an allocation times out, preserve completed checkpoints and report incomplete
diagnostics; do not extend or resubmit without new approval.

The stud QoS permits one running and two submitted jobs. Submit seed 0 and seed 1
(afterany seed 0). At the start of seed 1, submit seed 2 (afterany seed 1), before
training. Per-seed exclusive submission locks and durable receipts prevent
duplicate submissions. A prior seed failure does not change later seeds' fresh
initializations. Submission ambiguity blocks automatic retry.

# MedSAM3 BG/A/P replication: folds 0, 1, 3 × seeds 17, 83, 191

The user requested three seeds on folds 0, 1 and 3 following the multiclass fold-0 seed-46 pilot. There are nine matched comparisons, each with baseline, bands and bands+edge: 27 newly fine-tuned adapters. The seed-46 pilot remains separate and is excluded from this replication's average.

Use the previous binary study's frozen support and validation sets for each fold: five support volumes per fold; 46, 52 and 44 validation volumes respectively. The three support sets total 15 distinct volumes; the validation sets total 142 distinct volumes and exclude every support volume. Retain all new runs regardless of outcome. These folds were selected after prior binary outcomes, so this is exploratory and is not a full or unbiased cross-validation estimate. Patient identities remain unavailable.

The class model, text prompts, semantic probability projection, native objectives and classwise constraints are identical to the completed three-class pilot. Keep 200 optimizer updates, two adjacent-slice pairs per update, learning-rate schedule, warmup and LoRA initialization unchanged. Each arm independently resets the same adapter and optimization RNG, and replays the same sampling schedule for that comparison. Save all final checkpoints, training traces and three-class predictions for training and validation.

## Exact calibration per fold

Calculate training-only calibration once in seed 17 for each fold, with calibration RNG seed 20260929. Seeds 83 and 191 reuse that exact audited calibration JSON and its SHA256. The reuse contract binds support-image/label hashes, class definitions/prompts, probability projection, constraint definitions, initial adapter and frozen parameter hashes, and calibration settings. The same bands coefficient is used in both constrained arms. No validation-dependent tuning or early stopping occurs.

## Audit and reporting

After each comparison, independently reload the saved masks and probabilities. Verify input/output/checkpoint hashes, probability normalization, mask=argmax, voxel grids, all 3×3 confusion counts and per-class Dice. Check all 200 training records, the objective components and weights, matching initialization/sample/LR schedules, unchanged frozen parameters and distinct final adapters. Require exactly identical calibration files across the three seeds in a fold before aggregation.

The primary Dice is the arithmetic mean of anterior and posterior Dice for each validation volume; background Dice is reported separately. First average volumes within each seed, then equally average the three seeds within each fold. Report seed standard deviation, paired gain over baseline and number of improved seeds. An overall summary weights the three folds equally.

Primary error categories are disjoint: foreground FP = background predicted as anterior/posterior; foreground FN = anterior/posterior predicted as background; A→P and P→A = swaps. Report each as mean voxels per validation volume, then equal-seed averages per fold. Also report class-specific FP/FN, which include swaps and must not be added again to the disjoint categories. Preserve all individual seed summaries and per-volume records.

## Execution and storage

Submit one 12-hour GPU job per fold, with its three seeds sequential. An accompanying checkpoint-delivery process uses the already verified login-node file `/tmp/medsam3-3160552-staging/sam3.cdn.pt` and `sbcast` to each allocated job's private tmpfs. The checkpoint is never copied to BeeGFS. A CPU aggregation job depends on successful completion of all three fold jobs; it requires all nine independent audits before writing the final Markdown/JSON report.

Uncompressed prediction/adapter budget after two-copy mirroring is 5.999 GiB for all nine comparisons. Require 7.499 GiB free before submission: output budget + 1 GiB reserve + 0.5 GiB startup headroom. Compute-node guards recheck the budget of outstanding comparisons plus the 1 GiB runtime reserve. The authorized removal of binary generated artifacts occurs only after saving the complete binary results in Markdown and hashed metadata. Pretrained weights, datasets, shared runtimes, source and the multiclass pilot are retained.

Protocol evidence: ap_swap_mechanism_20260919_01/PROTOCOL.md
# Frozen-prediction A/P mechanism audit

19 September 2026. Exploratory continuation, not a confirmatory test. No training,
optimizer steps, or changes to original experiments. At most one 20-minute
GPU allocation for identity-input inference; CPU analysis afterwards.

## Frozen scope before spatial results

Fold 0, original 10 training / 52 validation cases, seeds 0/1/2, baseline/bands,
75- and maximum-200-epoch schedules, best and latest checkpoints (24 records).
Use each experiment's frozen source and existing cluster environment. Verify
checkpoint, config, data and split hashes against previously audited files.
Compare fresh confusion matrices to archived counts; never silently substitute
new inference for old numbers. Cache hard predictions and conditional A/P
probabilities with GT only for downstream scoring. All transformations receive
predictions only; GT is never an input to a deployable correction.

Fixed diagnostic corrections, without validation tuning:

1. Raw prediction.
2. Single hard-label best-fit coronal plane on predicted foreground.
3. Same plane estimated from the largest 6-connected foreground component.
4. Same plane estimated from a one-voxel, 6-neighbour erosion of that component;
   fallback to the component, then original prediction if no two-class cut exists.
5. Conditional A/P log-likelihood plane on the largest component (voxel-weighted).
6. Same conditional score, but each occupied slice contributes equally.
7. Three-seed majority conditional A/P vote, preserving each recipient foreground.
8. Three-seed median hard fitted cut, preserving each recipient foreground.

All plane projections change only A/P labels within the recipient's existing
foreground. Verify its binary mask is exactly unchanged. Report label-specific
Dice because relabeling background false positives can affect that metric even
when binary foreground errors are fixed. Tie convention: earliest minimizing
cut; report ties and distance to the nearest GT optimum separately.

Diagnostic-only oracle: project to GT best-fit plane; never deploy or use for
candidate selection. Count remaining GT nonplanarity, shifts, swaps inside the
cut-displacement slab, and swaps outside it. Quantify baseline/bands same-voxel
transitions and conditional A/P accuracy on common recovered GT foreground.

Report every prespecified method, every seed and both checkpoints; emphasize
best checkpoints selected by historical overall Dice. Ensemble correction has
three-model inference cost and is not a single-model loss improvement. Do not
claim independence for repeated seeds/cases or use this reused validation set
as a final test. A promising exploratory result requires later frozen-method
replication. No new training is authorized by this protocol.

# One augmented seed-0 plain boundary-band BCE pilot

User request: test the previously proposed band CE before further dropout exploration. Compare fresh mild_v1 augmentation + Dice + plain grouped outer-boundary BCE with the completed mild_v1 + Dice seed-0 baseline. Dropout stays zero; no A/P, focal, Tversky, teacher, ray or equivariance term.

The auxiliary groups anterior and posterior as hippocampal foreground. Build inner and outer bands using two six-neighbor morphological steps on the current transformed label. Average BCE within each side, balance the two sides equally and average valid patients. The three-class Dice term still supervises the A/P labels. This is targeted boundary supervision, not a new anatomical prior.

Keep fold 0, 208/52 cases, batch 1, 64³, no resize, AdamW explicit weight decay 1e-5, LR 1e-4, StepLR 20/gamma 0.5, AMP, plain tensors, zero workers and no activation checkpointing. Maximum 50 epochs; minimum 25, patience 8 and minimum improvement 0.0005. Five-epoch linear auxiliary warmup. One forward and one combined backward per training batch.

Within the single Slurm job, first train a matched five-epoch augmented Dice control from scratch. Calibrate on its final epoch-five checkpoint, never selected by validation. Use 32 deterministic training-only cases with the same mild_v1 implementation and seed+1 augmentation generator. Target auxiliary median logit-gradient RMS at 10% of Dice; retain the 50% tail cap. Bind the calibration to augmentation policy, RNG seed, input and split hashes, preprocessing, source, runtime, device and source checkpoint. The production run starts from scratch and does not load the calibration checkpoint.

Before production, compare baseline/candidate/candidate/baseline three-epoch timing blocks, discarding each first epoch. Require ≤5% median overhead in both training and total epoch time, ≤1.15 maximum measured epoch ratio, exact expected forward counts, and baseline first-three-epoch parity within 1e-5. Record the separate calibration-source and calibration costs. Keep the calibration checkpoint, but hash and remove disposable timing checkpoints after each block, retaining logs, metrics and cleanup records. Failure prevents production.

After stopping, verify artifact hashes and audit both selected and final checkpoints against the original augmented baseline on all clean training and validation cases. Export per-case confusion matrices, Dice, total errors, foreground FP/FN, both A/P swap directions and boundary/calibration statistics, with paired case-bootstrap intervals. Interpret seed-0 results as exploratory; inspect overall performance rather than the train–validation gap alone. A practical pilot target is +0.2 percentage points validation Dice with fewer total errors and no substantial class or lower-tail regression, supported by both checkpoint policies; this is not a significance test.

Submit only this one experiment, keep the existing A/P follow-up on hold and never exceed two queued/running jobs. Check BeeGFS quota before submission. Do not promote a new baseline without replication.

## Throughput retry

Attempt 660468 stopped before production at the strict runtime gate: +5.70% total-epoch and +7.10% training overhead, with exact baseline parity. Attempt 02 consolidates repeated valid-row filtering inside the band loss, preserving its reductions and gradients. It includes an old/new GPU loss-and-gradient parity check and isolated profiler, then repeats calibration and the unchanged full-epoch runtime gate. No statistical settings or thresholds are changed.

Attempt 660475 also stopped before production (+5.89% epoch, +7.35% training overhead), despite a 14% isolated auxiliary speedup. Attempt 03 additionally uses the algebraically equivalent logaddexp for the canonical two-foreground/one-background grouping and skips sum kernels on singleton diagnostic tensors. GPU numerical and full-epoch gates remain unchanged.

Attempt 660489 met the epoch limit (+4.57%) but failed training-only (+5.78%). Attempt 04 caches the immutable per-device morphology kernel and combines the six equivalent face-touch reductions. Geometry, loss, calibration and acceptance thresholds remain unchanged.

# Dice-only baseline with validation early stopping

User-authorized submission: fold 0, seed 0, from-scratch Dice-only SwinUNETR.

## Fixed training settings

- MSD Task04, canonical 208 training / 52 validation split, 64³ inputs, no resize.
- Batch size 1; no translation augmentation or auxiliary constraint; AMP enabled.
- AdamW: learning rate 1e-4, weight decay 1e-5; StepLR every 20 epochs, factor 0.5.
- Maximum 50 epochs. Validation hard foreground Dice every epoch.
- Patience 8, significant improvement strictly greater than 0.0005 over the last
  significant reference score; earliest stop epoch 25.
- Best checkpoint uses every strict improvement in raw validation hard Dice,
  including improvements smaller than the patience threshold.
- At termination, export and evaluate the best checkpoint. Preserve latest
  weights/optimizer/scheduler/RNG at the stopping epoch for reproducible resume.
- Replay durable metric history on resume to recover the stopping state. If a
  stopped run resumes, finalize/evaluate it without any new optimizer updates.
- Existing validation confidence diagnostics enabled; W&B disabled as in the
  historical matched baseline. No NLL-based selection rule is added.

## Evaluation and interpretation

After training, evaluate the new best/latest and the historical matched seed-0
baseline best/latest on the identical 208 training and 52 validation cases.
Record the same supervised Dice loss, foreground soft/hard Dice, confusion counts,
NLL/Brier/ECE, error confidence, and per-case metrics for both cohorts. The new
best versus historical best comparison tests reproducibility; the new best versus
historical epoch 50 comparison quantifies checkpoint-selection benefit.

Early stopping does not change optimizer updates before termination. If trajectories
match, expect the historical epoch-16 model selected around stopping epoch 25.
The baseline has been inspected repeatedly on fold 0; this rerun does not constitute
independent evidence of improved generalization to a new fold.

## Artifacts

- Frozen source and file-level manifest in the dedicated cluster experiment root.
- `runs/dice_early_stopping_fold0_seed0/metrics.csv`, best/latest checkpoints,
  `final_metrics.json`, `completion_manifest.json`, and selected `MSD_fold0/model.pt`.
- `generalization_audit/`: separate JSONs for four checkpoint/cohort comparisons,
  with checkpoint/data/config hashes and an aggregate `summary.json`.
- `SUBMISSION.json`: job identity and verified submission parameters.

## Checks before submission

The stopping controller and trainer are covered by tests for accumulated small
improvements, minimum epoch, disabled behavior, interruption/resume, early-stop
finalization, restoring a raw best smaller than min_delta, and rejection of changed
resume settings. Existing follow-up training tests cover unchanged default paths.
The audit evaluator is checked against perfect and confidently wrong synthetic logits.

# Five-percent augmented boundary-band pilot, seed 0

User authorized trying the recommended ordinary boundary-band BCE after the low-data error audit.

Submit one Slurm job. Keep the exact ten training cases and 52 validation cases from completed job 661170. Use mild_v1, Dice plus plain two-step inner/outer band BCE, focal gamma zero, batch one, seed zero, no dropout, no other constraints. The production model starts fresh with the same initialization and independent augmentation RNG as the baseline.

Reuse the verified frozen source of the previous successful augmented-band experiment, source digest ab972a098df39cbb874838a6e0009936a7497224db7bdf5c72eb427f3c433940. Preserve the old source and all completed experiments. Verify an exact copy before and after execution.

Calibration: a fixed five-epoch Dice-only run on the ten-case subset; its latest checkpoint is selected by epoch, not validation. Verify its first-five-epoch losses and Dice against the existing baseline within 1e-5. Calibrate on all ten training cases with deterministic mild_v1 views, target median band-gradient RMS 10% of Dice and existing 50% tail cap. Do not use the full-data model, the excluded 198 training labels, or validation labels to fit the coefficient.

GPU preflight: three fresh epochs with the calibrated band loss fully active, verify finite losses, nonzero auxiliary, and exactly 30 training plus 208 evaluation forwards. This disposable run is not the production initialization. Record runtime; the unchanged core implementation already passed full-data performance gates.

Production: maximum 50 epochs, early stopping minimum 25, patience 8, min_delta 0.0005; five-epoch linear auxiliary warmup. AdamW LR 1e-4, weight decay 1e-5, StepLR20 gamma0.5, 64-cubed crop/pad, no resize, AMP, plain tensors, no activation checkpointing, zero workers. One model forward and one combined backward per training batch.

After completion, automatically compare both best and final checkpoints to job 661170 on clean ten-case training and 52-case validation cohorts. Record Dice, foreground FP/FN, both A/P swap directions, calibration, and paired exploratory case-bootstrap intervals.

Interpretation: this tests an auxiliary under the same short 500-update ceiling as the baseline. It does not establish label efficiency independently of optimization time, anatomical novelty, or generalization to an untouched test set. No additional architecture, CE-control, or longer-budget training experiment is included.

# Longer-budget 5% augmented seed-0 baseline

User authorized one fresh baseline training run to test whether extending training reduces the observed boundary-band advantage.

## Fixed choices

- Original fold 0, same ten labelled cases (subset seed 0), same 52 validation cases.
- Fresh model seed 0; augmentation RNG seed 1; mild_v1 augmentation; Dice-only objective.
- Same AdamW, LR 1e-4, weight decay 1e-5, StepLR every 20 epochs with gamma 0.5. Continue the schedule through epoch 75; do not reset or stretch it. Thus the nominal learning rate drops again after epoch 60.
- Batch 1, 64-cubed crop/pad, no resize, no dropout, AMP, plain tensors, no activation checkpointing, zero workers.
- Change maximum epochs from 50 to 75 and minimum early-stopping epoch from 25 to 60. Preserve patience 8 and minimum significant validation-Dice improvement 0.0005. Earliest possible stop is epoch 60; latest is 75. Best checkpoint can still come from an earlier epoch.
- At most 750 optimizer updates. This is a fresh run, not a resume or warm start from the old checkpoint.
- Frozen source ab972a098df39cbb874838a6e0009936a7497224db7bdf5c72eb427f3c433940, used by the verified seed-0 band experiment and seed-1/2 pair replications. No trainer or loss edits. The original seed-0 baseline used source 79d59655; the later snapshot previously reproduced its five-epoch calibration control. Compare the full first-50-epoch trajectory again to expose any difference.

## Audit

Verify the source snapshot and exact launch-file hashes before training. Preserve the original runs. After training, compare first-50-epoch supervised loss, validation hard/soft Dice and LR against the original seed-0 baseline (report maximum differences, tolerance 1e-5). Re-evaluate best and final checkpoints of the extended baseline, original 50-epoch baseline, and original 50-epoch bands on clean training/validation cohorts. Save all paired case-level comparisons and error/calibration diagnostics.

This job trains only the new baseline. The old runs receive inference only. The comparison tests whether this baseline catches up within the extended schedule; stopping or reaching the cap does not by itself establish optimization convergence. It is a one-seed follow-up on reused validation, with a longer checkpoint-selection opportunity. No fold-1 or extended-band training is included.

# Dice-only baseline with validation early stopping

User-authorized submission: fold 0, seed 0, from-scratch Dice-only SwinUNETR.

## Fixed training settings

- MSD Task04, canonical 208 training / 52 validation split, 64³ inputs, no resize.
- Batch size 1; no translation augmentation or auxiliary constraint; AMP enabled.
- AdamW: learning rate 1e-4, weight decay 1e-5; StepLR every 20 epochs, factor 0.5.
- Maximum 50 epochs. Validation hard foreground Dice every epoch.
- Patience 8, significant improvement strictly greater than 0.0005 over the last
  significant reference score; earliest stop epoch 25.
- Best checkpoint uses every strict improvement in raw validation hard Dice,
  including improvements smaller than the patience threshold.
- At termination, export and evaluate the best checkpoint. Preserve latest
  weights/optimizer/scheduler/RNG at the stopping epoch for reproducible resume.
- Replay durable metric history on resume to recover the stopping state. If a
  stopped run resumes, finalize/evaluate it without any new optimizer updates.
- Existing validation confidence diagnostics enabled; W&B disabled as in the
  historical matched baseline. No NLL-based selection rule is added.

## Evaluation and interpretation

After training, evaluate the new best/latest and the historical matched seed-0
baseline best/latest on the identical 208 training and 52 validation cases.
Record the same supervised Dice loss, foreground soft/hard Dice, confusion counts,
NLL/Brier/ECE, error confidence, and per-case metrics for both cohorts. The new
best versus historical best comparison tests reproducibility; the new best versus
historical epoch 50 comparison quantifies checkpoint-selection benefit.

Early stopping does not change optimizer updates before termination. If trajectories
match, expect the historical epoch-16 model selected around stopping epoch 25.
The baseline has been inspected repeatedly on fold 0; this rerun does not constitute
independent evidence of improved generalization to a new fold.

## Artifacts

- Frozen source and file-level manifest in the dedicated cluster experiment root.
- `runs/dice_early_stopping_fold0_seed0/metrics.csv`, best/latest checkpoints,
  `final_metrics.json`, `completion_manifest.json`, and selected `MSD_fold0/model.pt`.
- `generalization_audit/`: separate JSONs for four checkpoint/cohort comparisons,
  with checkpoint/data/config hashes and an aggregate `summary.json`.
- `SUBMISSION.json`: job identity and verified submission parameters.

## Checks before submission

The stopping controller and trainer are covered by tests for accumulated small
improvements, minimum epoch, disabled behavior, interruption/resume, early-stop
finalization, restoring a raw best smaller than min_delta, and rejection of changed
resume settings. Existing follow-up training tests cover unchanged default paths.
The audit evaluator is checked against perfect and confidently wrong synthetic logits.

# One augmented seed-0 plain boundary-band BCE pilot

User request: test the previously proposed band CE before further dropout exploration. Compare fresh mild_v1 augmentation + Dice + plain grouped outer-boundary BCE with the completed mild_v1 + Dice seed-0 baseline. Dropout stays zero; no A/P, focal, Tversky, teacher, ray or equivariance term.

The auxiliary groups anterior and posterior as hippocampal foreground. Build inner and outer bands using two six-neighbor morphological steps on the current transformed label. Average BCE within each side, balance the two sides equally and average valid patients. The three-class Dice term still supervises the A/P labels. This is targeted boundary supervision, not a new anatomical prior.

Keep fold 0, 208/52 cases, batch 1, 64³, no resize, AdamW explicit weight decay 1e-5, LR 1e-4, StepLR 20/gamma 0.5, AMP, plain tensors, zero workers and no activation checkpointing. Maximum 50 epochs; minimum 25, patience 8 and minimum improvement 0.0005. Five-epoch linear auxiliary warmup. One forward and one combined backward per training batch.

Within the single Slurm job, first train a matched five-epoch augmented Dice control from scratch. Calibrate on its final epoch-five checkpoint, never selected by validation. Use 32 deterministic training-only cases with the same mild_v1 implementation and seed+1 augmentation generator. Target auxiliary median logit-gradient RMS at 10% of Dice; retain the 50% tail cap. Bind the calibration to augmentation policy, RNG seed, input and split hashes, preprocessing, source, runtime, device and source checkpoint. The production run starts from scratch and does not load the calibration checkpoint.

Before production, compare baseline/candidate/candidate/baseline three-epoch timing blocks, discarding each first epoch. Require ≤5% median overhead in both training and total epoch time, ≤1.15 maximum measured epoch ratio, exact expected forward counts, and baseline first-three-epoch parity within 1e-5. Record the separate calibration-source and calibration costs. Keep the calibration checkpoint, but hash and remove disposable timing checkpoints after each block, retaining logs, metrics and cleanup records. Failure prevents production.

After stopping, verify artifact hashes and audit both selected and final checkpoints against the original augmented baseline on all clean training and validation cases. Export per-case confusion matrices, Dice, total errors, foreground FP/FN, both A/P swap directions and boundary/calibration statistics, with paired case-bootstrap intervals. Interpret seed-0 results as exploratory; inspect overall performance rather than the train–validation gap alone. A practical pilot target is +0.2 percentage points validation Dice with fewer total errors and no substantial class or lower-tail regression, supported by both checkpoint policies; this is not a significance test.

It is a one-seed follow-up on reused validation, with a longer checkpoint-selection opportunity. No fold-1 or extended-band training is included.

# Edge consistency at 5% training data

User-authorized experiment: fold 0, model seeds 0/1/2, maximum 75 epochs and
early stopping. Three new runs; reuse the six existing seed-matched Dice and
ordinary-bands controls from low_data_noaug_seed{0,1,2}_20260917_01.

Use the exact historical ten training case files (approximately 5% of 208),
the same 52 validation cases, no augmentation, padded 64^3 inputs, batch one,
AMP, no dropout or activation checkpointing. AdamW lr 1e-4, weight decay 1e-5,
StepLR factor 0.5 every 20 epochs. Keep the historical stopping rule: patience
8, min delta 0.0005, minimum 60 epochs, maximum 75. Best checkpoint is exact
maximum validation macro hard Dice, independent of the min-delta stop reference.
Split SHA256: 7b69e54dd720b38f58f11e73302899e626ab3985d5c15d5c72c5daeb420ce8be.

Loss: Dice + min(epoch/5,1) * (historical ordinary-bands loss + lambda_edge *
signed-face consistency). Same whole-foreground signed probability differences
and uniform face averaging in both-endpoint two-band support as the completed
full-data experiment. No degree weighting and no additional head.

Preserve each seed's ordinary-bands coefficient. Recalibrate lambda_edge
using ONLY its ten training cases and retained seed-matched epoch-five Dice
checkpoint: median weighted edge/base logit-gradient RMS ratio 0.1, capped at
p95 ratio 0.5. Base is Dice plus its ordinary bands. No full-data checkpoint,
case, coefficient or validation outcome enters coefficient calibration.
Reinitialize model and RNG streams after calibration; training starts from
scratch. No historical baseline or calibration-source training is repeated.

For speed, record first crossing and first three-consecutive-epoch crossing
of each seed's historical best Dice and best bands Dice, plus fixed Dice
levels 0.70/0.74/0.76/0.78/0.80. Preserve unreached thresholds as null. Report
epochs and optimizer updates (10 per epoch), selected/final Dice, fixed-epoch
scores and mean curve score over the common observed horizon. Do not fill or
extrapolate stopped histories. Compare each seed with its matching controls
before averaging; report every seed, including failures or unfavorable results.

GPU request is 3g.40gb; historical controls used 4g.40gb. Therefore epochs and
updates can support learning-speed comparisons, while observed runtimes are
descriptive and cannot establish a hardware-controlled wall-clock speedup.
Record calibration and training-including-I/O duration separately; calibration
reuses an existing checkpoint, whose original training cost is not included
in the new job duration.

After each run, audit selected Dice/bands/edge checkpoints on all ten training
and 52 validation cases without augmentation: Dice, inner FN, outer FP, AP
swaps, corrected/introduced errors, degree strata, and surface metrics. Also
report normalized train/validation effects as in the previous full-data audit.
Three seeds share the same subset and validation cohort; they are not three
independent datasets. Validation has already been used for development and
checkpoint selection. Do not claim independent test performance.

One sequential GPU job executes all three seeds. Reserve 3.2 GiB actual quota
before starting, retaining best/latest checkpoints plus selected exports.
No deletion is required if the observed 4.14 GiB available remains available.

# Full-data augmented A/P interface-distance-weighted pilot

This is a seed-0, fold-0 pilot on 208 training and 52 validation cases. It asks
whether concentrating a foreground-conditional original-label A/P logistic CE
near the internal A/P interface helps beyond the same uniform auxiliary. It is
not a global anatomical/order constraint and one seed does not establish
generalization.

The single production Slurm job runs three fresh arms sequentially: augmented
Dice; augmented Dice plus uniform conditional A/P CE; and augmented Dice plus
interface-distance-weighted conditional A/P CE. All use the same SwinUNETR,
Dice implementation, seed, data order, mild_v1 RNG stream, AdamW (1e-4,
weight decay 1e-5), StepLR (20, 0.5), AMP, batch size one, and identity-input
validation. Maximum training is 80 epochs, minimum 50, patience 12, and
meaningful-improvement delta 0.0005. Best checkpoints retain every strict Dice
improvement; latest is the explicit final/stopping checkpoint.

The interface contains both voxels of every face-sharing 1/2 contact in the
original or transformed released label. Foreground/background contacts do not
belong to it. R is the literal maximum Euclidean processed-grid distance from
any fold-0 training foreground voxel to that interface, after a 208-case
inventory is inspected. Validation labels never contribute. Weighted CE uses
`w = 1 + 4 * max(0, 1 - d/R)^2`, normalized by the sum of weights per valid
case. After accepted isotropic augmentation, `d_effective = d_aug / scale`;
identity, nonspatial, and rejected transforms use scale one. Absent interfaces
are explicitly invalid and never receive manufactured distances.

Both auxiliary coefficients are calibrated independently from the same
predeclared fresh baseline epoch-10 checkpoint and the same deterministic
32-training-case mild_v1 panel. The chosen coefficient is the smaller of the
weight matching the median auxiliary output-logit gradient RMS to 10% of the
median Dice RMS and the weight capping the auxiliary 95th-percentile RMS at
50% of the median Dice RMS. Calibration has a dedicated RNG and occurs before
either candidate is optimized.

The bounded GPU preflight runs analytic/augmentation/schedule tests, inventories
R, verifies the real data/model path, and measures full update, EDT, CPU/GPU
transfer, and checkpoint costs. Production ordinary updates use one network
forward. Maximum production optimizer updates are 49,920.

Best/final post-hoc diagnostics cover identity training and validation plus one
fixed augmented training view per case: class Dice, FP/FN, A-to-P and P-to-A,
raw conditional A/P errors on all GT foreground, distance-stratified swaps, and
cut fits only for axis-aligned views. Rotated-view cut geometry is explicitly
unmeasured. Only identity validation hard Dice selects checkpoints; matched
epoch curves are descriptive.

# One augmented seed-0 plain boundary-band BCE pilot

User request: test the previously proposed band CE before further dropout exploration. Compare fresh mild_v1 augmentation + Dice + plain grouped outer-boundary BCE with the completed mild_v1 + Dice seed-0 baseline. Dropout stays zero; no A/P, focal, Tversky, teacher, ray or equivariance term.

The auxiliary groups anterior and posterior as hippocampal foreground. Build inner and outer bands using two six-neighbor morphological steps on the current transformed label. Average BCE within each side, balance the two sides equally and average valid patients. The three-class Dice term still supervises the A/P labels. This is targeted boundary supervision, not a new anatomical prior.

Keep fold 0, 208/52 cases, batch 1, 64³, no resize, AdamW explicit weight decay 1e-5, LR 1e-4, StepLR 20/gamma 0.5, AMP, plain tensors, zero workers and no activation checkpointing. Maximum 50 epochs; minimum 25, patience 8 and minimum improvement 0.0005. Five-epoch linear auxiliary warmup. One forward and one combined backward per training batch.

Within the single Slurm job, first train a matched five-epoch augmented Dice control from scratch. Calibrate on its final epoch-five checkpoint, never selected by validation. Use 32 deterministic training-only cases with the same mild_v1 implementation and seed+1 augmentation generator. Target auxiliary median logit-gradient RMS at 10% of Dice; retain the 50% tail cap. Bind the calibration to augmentation policy, RNG seed, input and split hashes, preprocessing, source, runtime, device and source checkpoint. The production run starts from scratch and does not load the calibration checkpoint.

Before production, compare baseline/candidate/candidate/baseline three-epoch timing blocks, discarding each first epoch. Require ≤5% median overhead in both training and total epoch time, ≤1.15 maximum measured epoch ratio, exact expected forward counts, and baseline first-three-epoch parity within 1e-5. Record the separate calibration-source and calibration costs. Keep the calibration checkpoint, but hash and remove disposable timing checkpoints after each block, retaining logs, metrics and cleanup records. Failure prevents production.

After stopping, verify artifact hashes and audit both selected and final checkpoints against the original augmented baseline on all clean training and validation cases. Export per-case confusion matrices, Dice, total errors, foreground FP/FN, both A/P swap directions and boundary/calibration statistics, with paired case-bootstrap intervals. Interpret seed-0 results as exploratory; inspect overall performance rather than the train–validation gap alone. A practical pilot target is +0.2 percentage points validation Dice with fewer total errors and no substantial class or lower-tail regression, supported by both checkpoint policies; this is not a significance test.

Submit only this one experiment, keep the existing A/P follow-up on hold and never exceed two queued/running jobs. Check BeeGFS quota before submission. Do not promote a new baseline without replication.

## Throughput retry

Attempt 660468 stopped before production at the strict runtime gate: +5.70% total-epoch and +7.10% training overhead, with exact baseline parity. Attempt 02 consolidates repeated valid-row filtering inside the band loss, preserving its reductions and gradients. It includes an old/new GPU loss-and-gradient parity check and isolated profiler, then repeats calibration and the unchanged full-epoch runtime gate. No statistical settings or thresholds are changed.

Attempt 660475 also stopped before production (+5.89% epoch, +7.35% training overhead), despite a 14% isolated auxiliary speedup. Attempt 03 additionally uses the algebraically equivalent logaddexp for the canonical two-foreground/one-background grouping and skips sum kernels on singleton diagnostic tensors. GPU numerical and full-epoch gates remain unchanged.

Attempt 660489 met the epoch limit (+4.57%) but failed training-only (+5.78%). Attempt 04 caches the immutable per-device morphology kernel and combines the six equivalent face-touch reductions. Geometry, loss, calibration and acceptance thresholds remain unchanged.

# Dice-only baseline with validation early stopping

User-authorized submission: fold 0, seed 0, from-scratch Dice-only SwinUNETR.

## Fixed training settings

- MSD Task04, canonical 208 training / 52 validation split, 64³ inputs, no resize.
- Batch size 1; no translation augmentation or auxiliary constraint; AMP enabled.
- AdamW: learning rate 1e-4, weight decay 1e-5; StepLR every 20 epochs, factor 0.5.
- Maximum 50 epochs. Validation hard foreground Dice every epoch.
- Patience 8, significant improvement strictly greater than 0.0005 over the last
  significant reference score; earliest stop epoch 25.
- Best checkpoint uses every strict improvement in raw validation hard Dice,
  including improvements smaller than the patience threshold.
- At termination, export and evaluate the best checkpoint. Preserve latest
  weights/optimizer/scheduler/RNG at the stopping epoch for reproducible resume.
- Replay durable metric history on resume to recover the stopping state. If a
  stopped run resumes, finalize/evaluate it without any new optimizer updates.
- Existing validation confidence diagnostics enabled; W&B disabled as in the
  historical matched baseline. No NLL-based selection rule is added.

## Evaluation and interpretation

After training, evaluate the new best/latest and the historical matched seed-0
baseline best/latest on the identical 208 training and 52 validation cases.
Record the same supervised Dice loss, foreground soft/hard Dice, confusion counts,
NLL/Brier/ECE, error confidence, and per-case metrics for both cohorts. The new
best versus historical best comparison tests reproducibility; the new best versus
historical epoch 50 comparison quantifies checkpoint-selection benefit.

Early stopping does not change optimizer updates before termination. If trajectories
match, expect the historical epoch-16 model selected around stopping epoch 25.
The baseline has been inspected repeatedly on fold 0; this rerun does not constitute
independent evidence of improved generalization to a new fold.

## Artifacts

- Frozen source and file-level manifest in the dedicated cluster experiment root.
- `runs/dice_early_stopping_fold0_seed0/metrics.csv`, best/latest checkpoints,
  `final_metrics.json`, `completion_manifest.json`, and selected `MSD_fold0/model.pt`.
- `generalization_audit/`: separate JSONs for four checkpoint/cohort comparisons,
  with checkpoint/data/config hashes and an aggregate `summary.json`.
- `SUBMISSION.json`: job identity and verified submission parameters.

## Checks before submission

The stopping controller and trainer are covered by tests for accumulated small
improvements, minimum epoch, disabled behavior, interruption/resume, early-stop
finalization, restoring a raw best smaller than min_delta, and rejection of changed
resume settings. Existing follow-up training tests cover unchanged default paths.
The audit evaluator is checked against perfect and confidently wrong synthetic logits.

# Five-percent augmented boundary-band pilot, seed 0

User authorized trying the recommended ordinary boundary-band BCE after the low-data error audit.

Submit one Slurm job. Keep the exact ten training cases and 52 validation cases from completed job 661170. Use mild_v1, Dice plus plain two-step inner/outer band BCE, focal gamma zero, batch one, seed zero, no dropout, no other constraints. The production model starts fresh with the same initialization and independent augmentation RNG as the baseline.

Reuse the verified frozen source of the previous successful augmented-band experiment, source digest ab972a098df39cbb874838a6e0009936a7497224db7bdf5c72eb427f3c433940. Preserve the old source and all completed experiments. Verify an exact copy before and after execution.

Calibration: a fixed five-epoch Dice-only run on the ten-case subset; its latest checkpoint is selected by epoch, not validation. Verify its first-five-epoch losses and Dice against the existing baseline within 1e-5. Calibrate on all ten training cases with deterministic mild_v1 views, target median band-gradient RMS 10% of Dice and existing 50% tail cap. Do not use the full-data model, the excluded 198 training labels, or validation labels to fit the coefficient.

GPU preflight: three fresh epochs with the calibrated band loss fully active, verify finite losses, nonzero auxiliary, and exactly 30 training plus 208 evaluation forwards. This disposable run is not the production initialization. Record runtime; the unchanged core implementation already passed full-data performance gates.

Production: maximum 50 epochs, early stopping minimum 25, patience 8, min_delta 0.0005; five-epoch linear auxiliary warmup. AdamW LR 1e-4, weight decay 1e-5, StepLR20 gamma0.5, 64-cubed crop/pad, no resize, AMP, plain tensors, no activation checkpointing, zero workers. One model forward and one combined backward per training batch.

After completion, automatically compare both best and final checkpoints to job 661170 on clean ten-case training and 52-case validation cohorts. Record Dice, foreground FP/FN, both A/P swap directions, calibration, and paired exploratory case-bootstrap intervals.

Interpretation: this tests an auxiliary under the same short 500-update ceiling as the baseline. It does not establish label efficiency independently of optimization time, anatomical novelty, or generalization to an untouched test set. No additional architecture, CE-control, or longer-budget training experiment is included.

# Longer-budget 5% augmented seed-0 baseline

User authorized one fresh baseline training run to test whether extending training reduces the observed boundary-band advantage.

## Fixed choices

- Original fold 0, same ten labelled cases (subset seed 0), same 52 validation cases.
- Fresh model seed 0; augmentation RNG seed 1; mild_v1 augmentation; Dice-only objective.
- Same AdamW, LR 1e-4, weight decay 1e-5, StepLR every 20 epochs with gamma 0.5. Continue the schedule through epoch 75; do not reset or stretch it. Thus the nominal learning rate drops again after epoch 60.
- Batch 1, 64-cubed crop/pad, no resize, no dropout, AMP, plain tensors, no activation checkpointing, zero workers.
- Change maximum epochs from 50 to 75 and minimum early-stopping epoch from 25 to 60. Preserve patience 8 and minimum significant validation-Dice improvement 0.0005. Earliest possible stop is epoch 60; latest is 75. Best checkpoint can still come from an earlier epoch.
- At most 750 optimizer updates. This is a fresh run, not a resume or warm start from the old checkpoint.
- Frozen source ab972a098df39cbb874838a6e0009936a7497224db7bdf5c72eb427f3c433940, used by the verified seed-0 band experiment and seed-1/2 pair replications. No trainer or loss edits. The original seed-0 baseline used source 79d59655; the later snapshot previously reproduced its five-epoch calibration control. Compare the full first-50-epoch trajectory again to expose any difference.

## Audit

Verify the source snapshot and exact launch-file hashes before training. Preserve the original runs. After training, compare first-50-epoch supervised loss, validation hard/soft Dice and LR against the original seed-0 baseline (report maximum differences, tolerance 1e-5). Re-evaluate best and final checkpoints of the extended baseline, original 50-epoch baseline, and original 50-epoch bands on clean training/validation cohorts. Save all paired case-level comparisons and error/calibration diagnostics.

This job trains only the new baseline. The old runs receive inference only. The comparison tests whether this baseline catches up within the extended schedule; stopping or reaching the cap does not by itself establish optimization convergence. It is a one-seed follow-up on reused validation, with a longer checkpoint-selection opportunity. No fold-1 or extended-band training is included.

# Frozen protocol: 400-epoch stretched-schedule control, 10 cases (5%), fold 0, model seed 2

User request (18 September 2026): seed 2 did not converge under the 200-epoch control (job 662807: training soft-Dice loss 0.51 versus 0.15–0.19 for seeds 0/1; baseline best at epoch 167 of 169, still rising; bands gain +7.23 → +1.65 pp best, 51/52 cases). Train the seed-2 pair on a schedule exactly twice as long to see whether the remaining gain persists once seed 2 trains further.

## Design

Identical to the seed-2 run in `low_data_noaug_5pct_200ep_es_fold0_seeds12_20260918` except the schedule, which is exactly doubled:

| Setting | Original | 200-epoch control | This run |
|---|---|---|---|
| Max epochs | 75 | 200 | **400** |
| StepLR step (gamma 0.5) | 20 | 53 | **106** |
| Earliest stop (patience 8, min_delta 0.0005 on validation Dice) | 60 | 160 | **320** |
| LR phases | 1/21/41/61 | 1/54/107/160 | **1/107/213/319** (same four values, ending at 1.25e-5) |

Same cohort (original 10-case split file, 52 validation cases), frozen source ab972a098df39cbb874838a6e0009936a7497224db7bdf5c72eb427f3c433940, original seed-2 configuration (seed 2, translation seed 3), fresh seed-2 initialization for both arms, fresh seed-2 five-epoch calibration on all 10 cases with 1e-5 parity, best checkpoint = maximum validation hard Dice, MIG 3g.40gb (as the 200-epoch seed runs). One Slurm job, 2.5 h limit (≈50 min expected).

Learning-rate budget if all 400 epochs run: ≈1,960 initial-LR units (≈2× the 200-epoch control, ≈5.3× the original 75-epoch run, comparable to the 52-case pilot's 1,820).

## Interpretation limits

One seed, one fold; validation reused for selection. A still-longer run could change the plateau again. Comparisons with the 75-epoch original also span a GPU-slice change.

# One augmented seed-0 plain boundary-band BCE pilot

User request: test the previously proposed band CE before further dropout exploration. Compare fresh mild_v1 augmentation + Dice + plain grouped outer-boundary BCE with the completed mild_v1 + Dice seed-0 baseline. Dropout stays zero; no A/P, focal, Tversky, teacher, ray or equivariance term.

The auxiliary groups anterior and posterior as hippocampal foreground. Build inner and outer bands using two six-neighbor morphological steps on the current transformed label. Average BCE within each side, balance the two sides equally and average valid patients. The three-class Dice term still supervises the A/P labels. This is targeted boundary supervision, not a new anatomical prior.

Keep fold 0, 208/52 cases, batch 1, 64³, no resize, AdamW explicit weight decay 1e-5, LR 1e-4, StepLR 20/gamma 0.5, AMP, plain tensors, zero workers and no activation checkpointing. Maximum 50 epochs; minimum 25, patience 8 and minimum improvement 0.0005. Five-epoch linear auxiliary warmup. One forward and one combined backward per training batch.

Within the single Slurm job, first train a matched five-epoch augmented Dice control from scratch. Calibrate on its final epoch-five checkpoint, never selected by validation. Use 32 deterministic training-only cases with the same mild_v1 implementation and seed+1 augmentation generator. Target auxiliary median logit-gradient RMS at 10% of Dice; retain the 50% tail cap. Bind the calibration to augmentation policy, RNG seed, input and split hashes, preprocessing, source, runtime, device and source checkpoint. The production run starts from scratch and does not load the calibration checkpoint.

Before production, compare baseline/candidate/candidate/baseline three-epoch timing blocks, discarding each first epoch. Require ≤5% median overhead in both training and total epoch time, ≤1.15 maximum measured epoch ratio, exact expected forward counts, and baseline first-three-epoch parity within 1e-5. Record the separate calibration-source and calibration costs. Keep the calibration checkpoint, but hash and remove disposable timing checkpoints after each block, retaining logs, metrics and cleanup records. Failure prevents production.

After stopping, verify artifact hashes and audit both selected and final checkpoints against the original augmented baseline on all clean training and validation cases. Export per-case confusion matrices, Dice, total errors, foreground FP/FN, both A/P swap directions and boundary/calibration statistics, with paired case-bootstrap intervals. Interpret seed-0 results as exploratory; inspect overall performance rather than the train–validation gap alone. A practical pilot target is +0.2 percentage points validation Dice with fewer total errors and no substantial class or lower-tail regression, supported by both checkpoint policies; this is not a significance test.

Submit only this one experiment, keep the existing A/P follow-up on hold and never exceed two queued/running jobs. Check BeeGFS quota before submission. Do not promote a new baseline without replication.

## Throughput retry

Attempt 660468 stopped before production at the strict runtime gate: +5.70% total-epoch and +7.10% training overhead, with exact baseline parity. Attempt 02 consolidates repeated valid-row filtering inside the band loss, preserving its reductions and gradients. It includes an old/new GPU loss-and-gradient parity check and isolated profiler, then repeats calibration and the unchanged full-epoch runtime gate. No statistical settings or thresholds are changed.

Attempt 660475 also stopped before production (+5.89% epoch, +7.35% training overhead), despite a 14% isolated auxiliary speedup. Attempt 03 additionally uses the algebraically equivalent logaddexp for the canonical two-foreground/one-background grouping and skips sum kernels on singleton diagnostic tensors. GPU numerical and full-epoch gates remain unchanged.

Attempt 660489 met the epoch limit (+4.57%) but failed training-only (+5.78%). Attempt 04 caches the immutable per-device morphology kernel and combines the six equivalent face-touch reductions. Geometry, loss, calibration and acceptance thresholds remain unchanged.

# Dice-only baseline with validation early stopping

User-authorized submission: fold 0, seed 0, from-scratch Dice-only SwinUNETR.

## Fixed training settings

- MSD Task04, canonical 208 training / 52 validation split, 64³ inputs, no resize.
- Batch size 1; no translation augmentation or auxiliary constraint; AMP enabled.
- AdamW: learning rate 1e-4, weight decay 1e-5; StepLR every 20 epochs, factor 0.5.
- Maximum 50 epochs. Validation hard foreground Dice every epoch.
- Patience 8, significant improvement strictly greater than 0.0005 over the last
  significant reference score; earliest stop epoch 25.
- Best checkpoint uses every strict improvement in raw validation hard Dice,
  including improvements smaller than the patience threshold.
- At termination, export and evaluate the best checkpoint. Preserve latest
  weights/optimizer/scheduler/RNG at the stopping epoch for reproducible resume.
- Replay durable metric history on resume to recover the stopping state. If a
  stopped run resumes, finalize/evaluate it without any new optimizer updates.
- Existing validation confidence diagnostics enabled; W&B disabled as in the
  historical matched baseline. No NLL-based selection rule is added.

## Evaluation and interpretation

After training, evaluate the new best/latest and the historical matched seed-0
baseline best/latest on the identical 208 training and 52 validation cases.
Record the same supervised Dice loss, foreground soft/hard Dice, confusion counts,
NLL/Brier/ECE, error confidence, and per-case metrics for both cohorts. The new
best versus historical best comparison tests reproducibility; the new best versus
historical epoch 50 comparison quantifies checkpoint-selection benefit.

Early stopping does not change optimizer updates before termination. If trajectories
match, expect the historical epoch-16 model selected around stopping epoch 25.
The baseline has been inspected repeatedly on fold 0; this rerun does not constitute
independent evidence of improved generalization to a new fold.

## Artifacts

- Frozen source and file-level manifest in the dedicated cluster experiment root.
- `runs/dice_early_stopping_fold0_seed0/metrics.csv`, best/latest checkpoints,
  `final_metrics.json`, `completion_manifest.json`, and selected `MSD_fold0/model.pt`.
- `generalization_audit/`: separate JSONs for four checkpoint/cohort comparisons,
  with checkpoint/data/config hashes and an aggregate `summary.json`.
- `SUBMISSION.json`: job identity and verified submission parameters.

## Checks before submission

The stopping controller and trainer are covered by tests for accumulated small
improvements, minimum epoch, disabled behavior, interruption/resume, early-stop
finalization, restoring a raw best smaller than min_delta, and rejection of changed
resume settings. Existing follow-up training tests cover unchanged default paths.
The audit evaluator is checked against perfect and confidently wrong synthetic logits.

# Five-percent augmented boundary-band pilot, seed 0

User authorized trying the recommended ordinary boundary-band BCE after the low-data error audit.

Use mild_v1, Dice plus plain two-step inner/outer band BCE, focal gamma zero, batch one, seed zero, no dropout, no other constraints. The production model starts fresh with the same initialization and independent augmentation RNG as the baseline.

Reuse the verified frozen source of the previous successful augmented-band experiment, source digest ab972a098df39cbb874838a6e0009936a7497224db7bdf5c72eb427f3c433940. Preserve the old source and all completed experiments. Verify an exact copy before and after execution.

Calibration: a fixed five-epoch Dice-only run on the ten-case subset; its latest checkpoint is selected by epoch, not validation. Verify its first-five-epoch losses and Dice against the existing baseline within 1e-5. Calibrate on all ten training cases with deterministic mild_v1 views, target median band-gradient RMS 10% of Dice and existing 50% tail cap. Do not use the full-data model, the excluded 198 training labels, or validation labels to fit the coefficient.

GPU preflight: three fresh epochs with the calibrated band loss fully active, verify finite losses, nonzero auxiliary, and exactly 30 training plus 208 evaluation forwards. This disposable run is not the production initialization. Record runtime; the unchanged core implementation already passed full-data performance gates.

Production: maximum 50 epochs, early stopping minimum 25, patience 8, min_delta 0.0005; five-epoch linear auxiliary warmup. One model forward and one combined backward per training batch.

Interpretation: this tests an auxiliary under the same short 500-update ceiling as the baseline. It does not establish label efficiency independently of optimization time, anatomical novelty, or generalization to an untouched test set. No additional architecture, CE-control, or longer-budget training experiment is included.

# Longer-budget 5% augmented seed-0 baseline

User authorized one fresh baseline training run to test whether extending training reduces the observed boundary-band advantage.

## Fixed choices

- Original fold 0, same ten labelled cases (subset seed 0), same 52 validation cases.
- Fresh model seed 0; augmentation RNG seed 1; mild_v1 augmentation; Dice-only objective.
- Same AdamW, LR 1e-4, weight decay 1e-5, StepLR every 20 epochs with gamma 0.5. Continue the schedule through epoch 75; do not reset or stretch it. Thus the nominal learning rate drops again after epoch 60.
- Batch 1, 64-cubed crop/pad, no resize, no dropout, AMP, plain tensors, no activation checkpointing, zero workers.
- Change maximum epochs from 50 to 75 and minimum early-stopping epoch from 25 to 60. Preserve patience 8 and minimum significant validation-Dice improvement 0.0005. Earliest possible stop is epoch 60; latest is 75. Best checkpoint can still come from an earlier epoch.
- At most 750 optimizer updates. This is a fresh run, not a resume or warm start from the old checkpoint.
- Frozen source ab972a098df39cbb874838a6e0009936a7497224db7bdf5c72eb427f3c433940, used by the verified seed-0 band experiment and seed-1/2 pair replications. No trainer or loss edits. The original seed-0 baseline used source 79d59655; the later snapshot previously reproduced its five-epoch calibration control. Compare the full first-50-epoch trajectory again to expose any difference.

## Audit

Verify the source snapshot and exact launch-file hashes before training. Preserve the original runs. After training, compare first-50-epoch supervised loss, validation hard/soft Dice and LR against the original seed-0 baseline (report maximum differences, tolerance 1e-5). Re-evaluate best and final checkpoints of the extended baseline, original 50-epoch baseline, and original 50-epoch bands on clean training/validation cohorts. Save all paired case-level comparisons and error/calibration diagnostics.

This job trains only the new baseline. The old runs receive inference only. The comparison tests whether this baseline catches up within the extended schedule; stopping or reaching the cap does not by itself establish optimization convergence. It is a one-seed follow-up on reused validation, with a longer checkpoint-selection opportunity. No fold-1 or extended-band training is included.

# Frozen protocol: 200-epoch stretched-schedule control with early stopping, 10 cases (5%), fold 0, model seed 0

User request (18 September 2026): train the original 5% fold-0 seed-0 baseline and bands pair for 200 epochs to test the working hypothesis that much of the 10-case bands gain is faster progress within a limited update budget. The user chose a proportionally stretched LR schedule, submitted as a single job with both arms, and then asked for plateau-based early stopping to avoid overfitting the 10 cases. This replaces cancelled job 662643 (earliest stop 200; never started).

## Cohort

Identical to the original 10-case pair: fold 0, the existing split file `low_data_5pct_augmented_seed0_20260917/splits_5pct_seed0.json` (SHA256 7b69e54d…ce8be, reused read-only by path), 10 training cases and the original 52 validation cases.

## What changes and what does not

| Setting | Original 10-case pair | This control |
|---|---|---|
| Maximum epochs | 75 | **200** |
| StepLR step (epochs), gamma 0.5 | 20 | **53** (= 20 × 200/75, rounded) |
| Earliest stopping epoch | 60 | **160** (= 60 × 200/75; first epoch of the final LR phase, as 61 was originally) |
| LR by epoch | 1e-4, 5e-5, 2.5e-5, 1.25e-5 from epochs 1/21/41/61 | same four values from epochs 1/54/107/160 |

Everything else is unchanged and frozen (source ab972a098df39cbb874838a6e0009936a7497224db7bdf5c72eb427f3c433940): SwinUNETR, preprocessing, no augmentation, Dice incl. background, AdamW LR 1e-4 / weight decay 1e-5, batch 1, AMP, seed 0, fresh initialization for both arms, early stopping on validation hard Dice with patience 8 / min_delta 0.0005 (active from epoch 160), best checkpoint = maximum validation hard Dice. Bands: γ=0, two six-neighbour steps, warmup min(e/5,1).

Keeping step 20 would add only ~8% learning-rate budget, since LR would be ≤1.25e-5 after epoch 60. If all 200 epochs run, the stretched schedule gives ~2.65× the original budget (LR summed over updates: 979 versus 369 initial-LR units; the 26-case pilot used 910, the 52-case 1,820). Epochs 1–20 have the same LR as the original run, so those epochs are expected to reproduce it.

## Calibration

A fresh five-epoch Dice-only source on all 10 cases (node-local /tmp), with a first-five-epoch parity check (1e-5) against the new baseline, a compact checkpoint and the unchanged calibrator `--max-cases 10 --seed 0` (all 10 cases, no validation). The first five epochs do not depend on the step size, so λ is expected to reproduce the original 0.0021935515; it is recomputed rather than reused.

## Execution

One Slurm job (stud, one 4g.40gb slice, 6 CPUs, 64 GiB, 2 h limit; ≈30 min): snapshot verification, baseline, bands (calibration source, calibration, production), then best/final evaluation of both arms on identical 10 training / 52 validation cases, paired comparisons and `PAIR_SUMMARY.json`.

## Interpretation limits

One seed on one fold; validation reused for selection. The stretched schedule changes the update budget and the timing of LR drops relative to the original pair, so this tests the combined effect of longer training at a matching LR shape, not an infinitely long run. It is a new experiment, not a replacement for the established four-fold result.

## Early-stopping note

Best-checkpoint selection (maximum validation hard Dice) is unaffected by the stopping epoch, so running past a validation peak cannot degrade the best-checkpoint result; early stopping affects the final checkpoint and compute. The earliest stop is set to 160 so a plateau cannot end training before the stretched schedule reaches its final LR phase.

Export per-case confusion matrices, Dice, total errors, foreground FP/FN, both A/P swap directions and boundary/calibration statistics, with paired case-bootstrap intervals. Interpret seed-0 results as exploratory; inspect overall performance rather than the train–validation gap alone. A practical pilot target is +0.2 percentage points validation Dice with fewer total errors and no substantial class or lower-tail regression, supported by both checkpoint policies; this is not a significance test.

Submit only this one experiment, keep the existing A/P follow-up on hold and never exceed two queued/running jobs. Check BeeGFS quota before submission. Do not promote a new baseline without replication.

## Throughput retry

Attempt 660468 stopped before production at the strict runtime gate: +5.70% total-epoch and +7.10% training overhead, with exact baseline parity. Attempt 02 consolidates repeated valid-row filtering inside the band loss, preserving its reductions and gradients. It includes an old/new GPU loss-and-gradient parity check and isolated profiler, then repeats calibration and the unchanged full-epoch runtime gate. No statistical settings or thresholds are changed.

Attempt 660475 also stopped before production (+5.89% epoch, +7.35% training overhead), despite a 14% isolated auxiliary speedup. Attempt 03 additionally uses the algebraically equivalent logaddexp for the canonical two-foreground/one-background grouping and skips sum kernels on singleton diagnostic tensors. GPU numerical and full-epoch gates remain unchanged.

Attempt 660489 met the epoch limit (+4.57%) but failed training-only (+5.78%). Attempt 04 caches the immutable per-device morphology kernel and combines the six equivalent face-touch reductions. Geometry, loss, calibration and acceptance thresholds remain unchanged.

# Dice-only baseline with validation early stopping

User-authorized submission: fold 0, seed 0, from-scratch Dice-only SwinUNETR.

## Fixed training settings

- MSD Task04, canonical 208 training / 52 validation split, 64³ inputs, no resize.
- Batch size 1; no translation augmentation or auxiliary constraint; AMP enabled.
- AdamW: learning rate 1e-4, weight decay 1e-5; StepLR every 20 epochs, factor 0.5.
- Maximum 50 epochs. Validation hard foreground Dice every epoch.
- Patience 8, significant improvement strictly greater than 0.0005 over the last
  significant reference score; earliest stop epoch 25.
- Best checkpoint uses every strict improvement in raw validation hard Dice,
  including improvements smaller than the patience threshold.
- At termination, export and evaluate the best checkpoint. Preserve latest
  weights/optimizer/scheduler/RNG at the stopping epoch for reproducible resume.
- Replay durable metric history on resume to recover the stopping state. If a
  stopped run resumes, finalize/evaluate it without any new optimizer updates.
- Existing validation confidence diagnostics enabled; W&B disabled as in the
  historical matched baseline. No NLL-based selection rule is added.

## Evaluation and interpretation

After training, evaluate the new best/latest and the historical matched seed-0
baseline best/latest on the identical 208 training and 52 validation cases.
Record the same supervised Dice loss, foreground soft/hard Dice, confusion counts,
NLL/Brier/ECE, error confidence, and per-case metrics for both cohorts. The new
best versus historical best comparison tests reproducibility; the new best versus
historical epoch 50 comparison quantifies checkpoint-selection benefit.

Early stopping does not change optimizer updates before termination. If trajectories
match, expect the historical epoch-16 model selected around stopping epoch 25.
The baseline has been inspected repeatedly on fold 0; this rerun does not constitute
independent evidence of improved generalization to a new fold.

## Artifacts

- Frozen source and file-level manifest in the dedicated cluster experiment root.
- `runs/dice_early_stopping_fold0_seed0/metrics.csv`, best/latest checkpoints,
  `final_metrics.json`, `completion_manifest.json`, and selected `MSD_fold0/model.pt`.
- `generalization_audit/`: separate JSONs for four checkpoint/cohort comparisons,
  with checkpoint/data/config hashes and an aggregate `summary.json`.
- `SUBMISSION.json`: job identity and verified submission parameters.

## Checks before submission

The stopping controller and trainer are covered by tests for accumulated small
improvements, minimum epoch, disabled behavior, interruption/resume, early-stop
finalization, restoring a raw best smaller than min_delta, and rejection of changed
resume settings. Existing follow-up training tests cover unchanged default paths.
The audit evaluator is checked against perfect and confidently wrong synthetic logits.

# Longer-budget 5% augmented seed-0 baseline

User authorized one fresh baseline training run to test whether extending training reduces the observed boundary-band advantage.

## Fixed choices

- Original fold 0, same ten labelled cases (subset seed 0), same 52 validation cases.
- Fresh model seed 0; augmentation RNG seed 1; mild_v1 augmentation; Dice-only objective.
- Same AdamW, LR 1e-4, weight decay 1e-5, StepLR every 20 epochs with gamma 0.5. Continue the schedule through epoch 75; do not reset or stretch it. Thus the nominal learning rate drops again after epoch 60.
- Batch 1, 64-cubed crop/pad, no resize, no dropout, AMP, plain tensors, no activation checkpointing, zero workers.
- Change maximum epochs from 50 to 75 and minimum early-stopping epoch from 25 to 60. Preserve patience 8 and minimum significant validation-Dice improvement 0.0005. Earliest possible stop is epoch 60; latest is 75. Best checkpoint can still come from an earlier epoch.
- At most 750 optimizer updates. This is a fresh run, not a resume or warm start from the old checkpoint.
- Frozen source ab972a098df39cbb874838a6e0009936a7497224db7bdf5c72eb427f3c433940, used by the verified seed-0 band experiment and seed-1/2 pair replications. No trainer or loss edits. The original seed-0 baseline used source 79d59655; the later snapshot previously reproduced its five-epoch calibration control. Compare the full first-50-epoch trajectory again to expose any difference.

## Audit

Verify the source snapshot and exact launch-file hashes before training. Preserve the original runs. After training, compare first-50-epoch supervised loss, validation hard/soft Dice and LR against the original seed-0 baseline (report maximum differences, tolerance 1e-5). Re-evaluate best and final checkpoints of the extended baseline, original 50-epoch baseline, and original 50-epoch bands on clean training/validation cohorts. Save all paired case-level comparisons and error/calibration diagnostics.

This job trains only the new baseline. The old runs receive inference only. The comparison tests whether this baseline catches up within the extended schedule; stopping or reaching the cap does not by itself establish optimization convergence. # Frozen protocol: 25% training data, fold 0, model seed 0, no augmentation

User request (18 September 2026): one matched pair on fold 0, model seed 0 — (1) Dice-only baseline and (2) identical training plus the calibrated boundary-bands constraint — using 25% of fold 0's training data. The only intended scientific change from the completed no-augmentation experiment is the training fraction. Seeds 1/2 and other folds are not submitted without a new decision.

## Cohort

Original five-fold split SHA256 1d6a3fe993359ad85e9c28a29901162251c3359449b710c09cb9e92d66dda472, trainer fold index 0 (208 training, 52 validation IDs). The saved `nested_subset_order` from `low_data_5pct_augmented_seed0_20260917/subset_manifest.json` is used and independently regenerated: `order = sorted(train); random.Random(0).shuffle(order)`. Training = `sorted(order[:52])` (exactly 25.0% of 208), which contains the previous 10-case subset. Validation = the original 52 IDs in original order. The split file keeps all five fold entries; only fold 0's training list is reduced. `subset_manifest.json` freezes permutation, IDs, hashes and the calibration sample before submission.

## Training (both arms, separate fresh processes, fresh seed-0 initialization)

Frozen source ab972a098df39cbb874838a6e0009936a7497224db7bdf5c72eb427f3c433940; run configuration identical to the completed fold-0 seed-0 no-augmentation 10-case baseline except the split path/hash. MONAI SwinUNETR (1 in, 3 out, dropout 0, no activation checkpointing); per-case nonzero z-score; pad/crop 64³; no augmentation or translation augmentation; batch 1; CUDA AMP; plain tensors. MONAI soft Dice including background, CE weight 0. AdamW LR 1e-4, weight decay 1e-5; StepLR(20, 0.5). Maximum 75 epochs, earliest stop 60, patience 8, min_delta 0.0005; best checkpoint = maximum validation hard Dice. With 52 cases each epoch has 52 optimizer updates (5.2× the 10-case experiment).

Bands arm: `constraint_set=bands`, focal_bce with shared/inner/outer gamma 0, two six-neighbour morphology steps, foreground [1,2], complement [0], float32 auxiliary; scale min(e/5,1) from epoch 1; `constraint_eval_every=0`; no GT-derived correction at inference.

## Calibration

A dedicated five-epoch Dice-only model is trained on all 52 training cases (same seed and settings) in node-local /tmp. Its first five epochs must match the production baseline's within 1e-5 (train loss, supervised loss, validation hard/soft Dice, learning rate). A compact checkpoint (epoch, model tensors, embedded run) is saved durably after a bitwise tensor comparison. The unchanged calibrator runs with `--max-cases 32 --seed 0`: its frozen `MAX_CALIBRATION_CASES = 32` cap means **32 of the 52 training cases** are sampled with `sorted(random.Random(0).sample(sorted(train), 32))`. The sampled IDs are pre-registered in the manifest and asserted afterward; no validation case is used. λ = min(0.10·median(d)/median(b), 0.50·median(d)/q95(b)) with RMS gradients over all output logits; the launcher recomputes it from the saved casewise gradients. The old 10-case weight is not reused. The production bands model starts from scratch.

## Execution and audits

One Slurm job (partition stud, one 4g.40gb GPU slice, 6 CPUs, 64 GiB, 2 h limit): snapshot verification, baseline, then bands (calibration source, calibration, production), each as a separate bootstrapped process under `set -euo pipefail`. After bands, best and final checkpoints of both arms are evaluated in eval/no-grad mode with AMP on identical unaugmented 52 training and 52 validation cases, followed by paired comparisons and `PAIR_SUMMARY.json`.

Expected persistent storage: 2 runs × 2 × 196 MB checkpoints + ~70 MB compact calibration checkpoint ≈ 0.86 GB logical (~1.7 GiB mirrored quota).

## Interpretation limits

Validation results (the validation set selects checkpoints and stopping); one model seed on one fixed subset; case IDs, not verified subjects. Cross-fraction comparison with the 10-case pair also changes the update count (5.2×) and the calibration sample (32/52 versus 10/10). The 75-epoch cap does not establish convergence.

# Longer-budget 5% augmented seed-0 baseline

User authorized one fresh baseline training run to test whether extending training reduces the observed boundary-band advantage.

## Fixed choices

- Original fold 0, same ten labelled cases (subset seed 0), same 52 validation cases.
- Fresh model seed 0; augmentation RNG seed 1; mild_v1 augmentation; Dice-only objective.
- Same AdamW, LR 1e-4, weight decay 1e-5, StepLR every 20 epochs with gamma 0.5. Continue the schedule through epoch 75; do not reset or stretch it. Thus the nominal learning rate drops again after epoch 60.
- Batch 1, 64-cubed crop/pad, no resize, no dropout, AMP, plain tensors, no activation checkpointing, zero workers.
- Change maximum epochs from 50 to 75 and minimum early-stopping epoch from 25 to 60. Preserve patience 8 and minimum significant validation-Dice improvement 0.0005. Earliest possible stop is epoch 60; latest is 75. Best checkpoint can still come from an earlier epoch.
- At most 750 optimizer updates. This is a fresh run, not a resume or warm start from the old checkpoint.
