# MedSAM3: supervised five-volume constraint ablation

The three arms start independently from the same released medical LoRA weights:
native SAM3 objective; native + bands; native + bands + edge. Only LoRA parameters
are trained. Constraints enter backpropagation; inference has no mask refinement.

The fixed support and validation cases, seed and optimizer settings are in
`protocol.json`. Each arm receives 200 AdamW updates, two slice pairs per update
(800 slice presentations), weight decay 0.01, gradient clipping at 1, and bf16.
Learning rate warms for 20 updates to 5e-5, then falls by cosine to 5e-6. The final
adapter is evaluated; validation never selects checkpoints or coefficients.

Training labels build the original two-step, six-connected inner and outer 3D
bands on each native canonical volume. Bands uses balanced inner/outer BCE,
without focal or degree weighting. Edge uses the original squared difference of
signed foreground residuals across positive-axis faces whose endpoints both lie
in the bands. Full-volume side counts and face counts are retained.

For each microstep, select a support volume uniformly, then an axial anchor
uniformly. Forward the anchor and its cyclic successor, and average their native
SAM3 objectives. Cyclic pairing gives uniform expected native slice exposure.
Bands uses the anchor plane; edge uses in-plane faces and the next-plane faces,
excluding any anatomical wraparound. Multiply these contributions by the volume
depth. Their expectations equal the original full-volume losses; tests compare
both loss values and gradients on non-cubic, empty, full and border-touching data.

SAM3 predicts instances. A differentiable semantic foreground field is the max
of native-size sigmoid mask logits multiplied by query and presence probabilities.
This representation adaptation is necessary for the original semantic losses.
No threshold, ground-truth matching, box prompt or point prompt enters this field.
BCE is computed in log-probability space, preserving corrective gradients even
at very low confidence. Edge uses the corresponding unclipped probabilities.
Native SAM3 losses retain upstream matching and their existing weights.

Coefficients are calibrated once at initialization, using four deterministic
band-bearing anchors from each of the five support volumes. Set bands' median
LoRA gradient norm ratio to 0.1 relative to native loss, capped at a 0.5 ratio at
the 95th percentile. Calibrate edge the same way relative to native + weighted
bands, including their gradient dot product. Zero constraint-gradient samples
are omitted and recorded; at least five nonzero samples are required. No model
updates occur during calibration. Both constraint coefficients ramp over 20
updates. Bands has the identical coefficient in both constrained arms.

Reset adapter weights and all RNGs before each arm; replay the exact same saved
volume/anchor schedule and use separate fresh optimizers. Record parameter hashes,
nonzero calibration gradients, per-update component losses and coefficients,
exposures, trained adapters, probabilities, masks and Dice confusion counts.

Inference uses only images and the text prompt `hippocampus`, with the same 0.5
confidence/NMS/mask settings across arms. Save all predictions for all arms before
opening validation labels. Score whole-hippocampus union Dice on five existing
development-validation volumes. This is a one-seed pilot, not a new independent
test cohort or a statistically conclusive estimate. These are five labelled
volumes, not five slices; patient identities are unavailable.

One Slurm GPU allocation runs calibration and all three arms sequentially.
Require at least 2 GiB free BeeGFS quota before submission and at worker startup.
Keep the base checkpoint and temporary caches on node-local storage; retain only
one final LoRA adapter per arm on BeeGFS.

# MedSAM3 five-shot: supervised bands and edge losses

Job **673386** completed on the Bocconi cluster in **53m 58s**, exit code 0.

All three arms independently fine-tuned the same medical LoRA initialization on five labelled volumes (011, 056, 146, 319, 363), with the frozen SAM3 backbone, seed 42, 200 updates and 800 slice presentations each. Bands and edge contributed to backpropagation. Predictions used plain MedSAM3 inference, without post-inference refinement.

Metric: 3D whole-hippocampus union Dice. Five separate development-validation volumes:

| Case | Baseline | + bands loss | + bands + edge losses |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| hippocampus_017 | 0.882673 | 0.892030 | 0.894930 |
| hippocampus_019 | 0.844195 | 0.857060 | 0.866724 |
| hippocampus_033 | 0.886264 | 0.889827 | 0.894042 |
| hippocampus_035 | 0.879560 | 0.876435 | 0.890062 |
| hippocampus_037 | 0.832705 | 0.837156 | 0.842238 |
| **Mean** | **0.865080** | **0.870502** | **0.877599** |

Bands improved mean Dice by **0.542 percentage points** (4/5 cases); bands+edge improved it by **1.252 points** (5/5 cases). Adding edge to bands gained a further **0.710 points**. These are descriptive results from one seed and five existing validation volumes, not evidence of statistical significance or an independent test cohort.

Training-only gradient calibration fixed bands weight at 10.20054594 and edge weight at 456.95353169. Both ramped over 20 updates. Bands used the same coefficient in both constrained arms. The sampling estimator preserves the original full-volume 3D bands and signed-face objectives; MedSAM3 instance outputs are projected to a differentiable semantic union. See [protocol](PROTOCOL.md) for the exact representation and calibration procedure.

Verification: 17 local checks passed, four loss checks also passed on the cluster, and GPU calibration verified finite nonzero LoRA gradients for both constraints on all 20 support slabs. The independent [audit](AUDIT.json) reproduced every Dice/confusion count, verified all 30 prediction hashes and grids, all 600 training objective records, identical initial adapters/sampling/LR schedules, exact first native loss agreement, unchanged frozen parameters and three distinct trained adapters. Training image/label hashes and validation label hashes matched the local dataset.

Quota: 4.34 GiB free before submission; 3.92 GiB after completion. The base checkpoint and temporary caches used node-local storage. Probabilities, masks, plots and records remain on the cluster at:

# Scoped review

Reviewed the new supervised loss bridge, matched training runner and single-job
launcher, including an independent adversarial code review using the review skill.

Fixed before submission:

- Cyclic native slice pairing preserves uniform expected slice exposure while
  anatomical edge faces explicitly exclude wraparound.
- Removed probability clipping that suppressed corrective bands gradients at low
  confidence. Stable foreground/complement log fields preserve finite gradients
  at logits of both -100 and +100.

Validation before submission: four new estimator/projection tests pass (including
full-volume value and gradient equivalence across four label configurations),
plus thirteen retained training/inference helper tests. Source compiles.
The independent reviewer reports no unresolved scoped findings. GPU calibration
is the integration check for simultaneous slice graphs and native backward calls.

Checked that all arms reset the adapter, RNGs and optimizer, replay the same
schedule, use training-only coefficient calibration, and finish all predictions
before evaluation labels are opened. No inference refinement is used.

Post-run: job 673386 completed all three arms. GPU calibration and the independent saved-prediction/training audit passed. No unresolved findings remain.

# One augmented seed-0 plain boundary-band BCE pilot

User request: test the previously proposed band CE before further dropout exploration. Compare fresh mild_v1 augmentation + Dice + plain grouped outer-boundary BCE with the completed mild_v1 + Dice seed-0 baseline. Dropout stays zero; no A/P, focal, Tversky, teacher, ray or equivariance term.

The auxiliary groups anterior and posterior as hippocampal foreground. Build inner and outer bands using two six-neighbor morphological steps on the current transformed label. Average BCE within each side, balance the two sides equally and average valid patients. The three-class Dice term still supervises the A/P labels. This is targeted boundary supervision, not a new anatomical prior.

Keep fold 0, 208/52 cases, batch 1, 64³, no resize, AdamW explicit weight decay 1e-5, LR 1e-4, StepLR 20/gamma 0.5, AMP, plain tensors, zero workers and no activation checkpointing. Maximum 50 epochs; minimum 25, patience 8 and minimum improvement 0.0005. Five-epoch linear auxiliary warmup. One forward and one combined backward per training batch.

Within the single Slurm job, first train a matched five-epoch augmented Dice control from scratch. Calibrate on its final epoch-five checkpoint, never selected by validation. Use 32 deterministic training-only cases with the same mild_v1 implementation and seed+1 augmentation generator. Target auxiliary median logit-gradient RMS at 10% of Dice; retain the 50% tail cap. Bind the calibration to augmentation policy, RNG seed, input and split hashes, preprocessing, source, runtime, device and source checkpoint. The production run starts from scratch and does not load the calibration checkpoint.

Before production, compare baseline/candidate/candidate/baseline three-epoch timing blocks, discarding each first epoch. Require ≤5% median overhead in both training and total epoch time, ≤1.15 maximum measured epoch ratio, exact expected forward counts, and baseline first-three-epoch parity within 1e-5. Record the separate calibration-source and calibration costs. Keep the calibration checkpoint, but hash and remove disposable timing checkpoints after each block, retaining logs, metrics and cleanup records. Failure prevents production.

After stopping, verify artifact hashes and audit both selected and final checkpoints against the original augmented baseline on all clean training and validation cases. Export per-case confusion matrices, Dice, total errors, foreground FP/FN, both A/P swap directions and boundary/calibration statistics, with paired case-bootstrap intervals. Interpret seed-0 results as exploratory; inspect overall performance rather than the train–validation gap alone. A practical pilot target is +0.2 percentage points validation Dice with fewer total errors and no substantial class or lower-tail regression, supported by both checkpoint policies; this is not a significance test.

Submit only this one experiment, keep the existing A/P follow-up on hold and never exceed two queued/running jobs. Check BeeGFS quota before submission. Do not promote a new baseline without replication.

## Throughput retry

Attempt 660468 stopped before production at the strict runtime gate: +5.70% total-epoch and +7.10% training overhead, with exact baseline parity. Attempt 02 consolidates repeated valid-row filtering inside the band loss, preserving its reductions and gradients. It includes an old/new GPU loss-and-gradient parity check and isolated profiler, then repeats calibration and the unchanged full-epoch runtime gate. No statistical settings or thresholds are changed.

Attempt 660475 also stopped before production (+5.89% epoch, +7.35% training overhead), despite a 14% isolated auxiliary speedup. Attempt 03 additionally uses the algebraically equivalent logaddexp for the canonical two-foreground/one-background grouping and skips sum kernels on singleton diagnostic tensors. GPU numerical and full-epoch gates remain unchanged.

Attempt 660489 met the epoch limit (+4.57%) but failed training-only (+5.78%). Attempt 04 caches the immutable per-device morphology kernel and combines the six equivalent face-touch reductions. Geometry, loss, calibration and acceptance thresholds remain unchanged.

# Dice-only baseline with validation early stopping

User-authorized submission: fold 0, seed 0, from-scratch Dice-only SwinUNETR.

## Fixed training settings

- MSD Task04, canonical 208 training / 52 validation split, 64³ inputs, no resize.
- Batch size 1; no translation augmentation or auxiliary constraint; AMP enabled.
- AdamW: learning rate 1e-4, weight decay 1e-5; StepLR every 20 epochs, factor 0.5.
- Maximum 50 epochs. Validation hard foreground Dice every epoch.
- Patience 8, significant improvement strictly greater than 0.0005 over the last
  significant reference score; earliest stop epoch 25.
- Best checkpoint uses every strict improvement in raw validation hard Dice,
  including improvements smaller than the patience threshold.
- At termination, export and evaluate the best checkpoint. Preserve latest
  weights/optimizer/scheduler/RNG at the stopping epoch for reproducible resume.
- Replay durable metric history on resume to recover the stopping state. If a
  stopped run resumes, finalize/evaluate it without any new optimizer updates.
- Existing validation confidence diagnostics enabled; W&B disabled as in the
  historical matched baseline. No NLL-based selection rule is added.

## Evaluation and interpretation

After training, evaluate the new best/latest and the historical matched seed-0
baseline best/latest on the identical 208 training and 52 validation cases.
Record the same supervised Dice loss, foreground soft/hard Dice, confusion counts,
NLL/Brier/ECE, error confidence, and per-case metrics for both cohorts. The new
best versus historical best comparison tests reproducibility; the new best versus
historical epoch 50 comparison quantifies checkpoint-selection benefit.

Early stopping does not change optimizer updates before termination. If trajectories
match, expect the historical epoch-16 model selected around stopping epoch 25.
The baseline has been inspected repeatedly on fold 0; this rerun does not constitute
independent evidence of improved generalization to a new fold.

## Artifacts

- Frozen source and file-level manifest in the dedicated cluster experiment root.
- `runs/dice_early_stopping_fold0_seed0/metrics.csv`, best/latest checkpoints,
  `final_metrics.json`, `completion_manifest.json`, and selected `MSD_fold0/model.pt`.
- `generalization_audit/`: separate JSONs for four checkpoint/cohort comparisons,
  with checkpoint/data/config hashes and an aggregate `summary.json`.
- `SUBMISSION.json`: job identity and verified submission parameters.

## Checks before submission

The stopping controller and trainer are covered by tests for accumulated small
improvements, minimum epoch, disabled behavior, interruption/resume, early-stop
finalization, restoring a raw best smaller than min_delta, and rejection of changed
resume settings. Existing follow-up training tests cover unchanged default paths.
The audit evaluator is checked against perfect and confidently wrong synthetic logits.

The production model starts fresh with the same initialization and independent augmentation RNG as the baseline.

Reuse the verified frozen source of the previous successful augmented-band experiment, source digest ab972a098df39cbb874838a6e0009936a7497224db7bdf5c72eb427f3c433940. Preserve the old source and all completed experiments. Verify an exact copy before and after execution.

Calibration: a fixed five-epoch Dice-only run on the ten-case subset; its latest checkpoint is selected by epoch, not validation. Verify its first-five-epoch losses and Dice against the existing baseline within 1e-5. Calibrate on all ten training cases with deterministic mild_v1 views, target median band-gradient RMS 10% of Dice and existing 50% tail cap. Interpretation: this tests an auxiliary under the same short 500-update ceiling as the baseline. It does not establish label efficiency independently of optimization time, anatomical novelty, or generalization to an untouched test set. No additional architecture, CE-control, or longer-budget training experiment is included.

# Longer-budget 5% augmented seed-0 baseline

User authorized one fresh baseline training run to test whether extending training reduces the observed boundary-band advantage.

## Fixed choices

- Original fold 0, same ten labelled cases (subset seed 0), same 52 validation cases.
- Fresh model seed 0; augmentation RNG seed 1; mild_v1 augmentation; Dice-only objective.
- Same AdamW, LR 1e-4, weight decay 1e-5, StepLR every 20 epochs with gamma 0.5. Continue the schedule through epoch 75; do not reset or stretch it. Thus the nominal learning rate drops again after epoch 60.
- Batch 1, 64-cubed crop/pad, no resize, no dropout, AMP, plain tensors, no activation checkpointing, zero workers.
- Change maximum epochs from 50 to 75 and minimum early-stopping epoch from 25 to 60. Preserve patience 8 and minimum significant validation-Dice improvement 0.0005. Earliest possible stop is epoch 60; latest is 75. Best checkpoint can still come from an earlier epoch.
- At most 750 optimizer updates. This is a fresh run, not a resume or warm start from the old checkpoint.
- Frozen source ab972a098df39cbb874838a6e0009936a7497224db7bdf5c72eb427f3c433940, used by the verified seed-0 band experiment and seed-1/2 pair replications. No trainer or loss edits. The original seed-0 baseline used source 79d59655; the later snapshot previously reproduced its five-epoch calibration control. Compare the full first-50-epoch trajectory again to expose any difference.

## Audit

Verify the source snapshot and exact launch-file hashes before training. Preserve the original runs. After training, compare first-50-epoch supervised loss, validation hard/soft Dice and LR against the original seed-0 baseline (report maximum differences, tolerance 1e-5). Re-evaluate best and final checkpoints of the extended baseline, original 50-epoch baseline, and original 50-epoch bands on clean training/validation cohorts. Save all paired case-level comparisons and error/calibration diagnostics.

This job trains only the new baseline. The old runs receive inference only. The comparison tests whether this baseline catches up within the extended schedule; stopping or reaching the cap does not by itself establish optimization convergence. It is a one-seed follow-up on reused validation, with a longer checkpoint-selection opportunity. No fold-1 or extended-band training is included.

# Frozen protocol: 10% training data (20 cases), fold 0, model seed 0, no augmentation

User request (18 September 2026, after the 26- and 52-case pilots): run 10% to locate where the bands benefit disappears. Under the established floor rule (as "5%" = floor(0.05 × 208) = 10 cases), 10% = floor(0.10 × 208) = **20 cases (9.6%)**. One matched pair on fold 0, model seed 0: (1) Dice-only baseline and (2) identical training plus the calibrated boundary-bands constraint. The only intended scientific change is the training fraction. No seed or fold extensions are submitted.

## Cohort

Original five-fold split SHA256 1d6a3fe993359ad85e9c28a29901162251c3359449b710c09cb9e92d66dda472, trainer fold index 0 (208 training, 52 validation IDs). The saved `nested_subset_order` (seed-0 permutation) is used and independently regenerated. Training = `sorted(order[:20])`, nested 10 ⊂ 20 ⊂ 26 ⊂ 52 with the earlier pilots. Validation = the original 52 IDs in original order. The split file keeps all five fold entries; only fold 0's training list is reduced.

## Training (both arms, separate fresh processes, fresh seed-0 initialization)

Frozen source ab972a098df39cbb874838a6e0009936a7497224db7bdf5c72eb427f3c433940; run configuration identical to the completed fold-0 seed-0 no-augmentation baseline except the split path/hash. MONAI SwinUNETR (1 in, 3 out, dropout 0, no activation checkpointing); per-case nonzero z-score; pad/crop 64³; no augmentation; batch 1; CUDA AMP; plain tensors. MONAI soft Dice including background, CE weight 0. AdamW LR 1e-4, weight decay 1e-5; StepLR(20, 0.5). Maximum 75 epochs, earliest stop 60, patience 8, min_delta 0.0005; best checkpoint = maximum validation hard Dice. 20 optimizer updates per epoch.

Bands arm: `constraint_set=bands`, focal_bce with shared/inner/outer gamma 0, two six-neighbour morphology steps, foreground [1,2], complement [0], float32 auxiliary; scale min(e/5,1) from epoch 1; `constraint_eval_every=0`; no GT-derived correction at inference.

## Calibration

A dedicated five-epoch Dice-only model is trained on all 20 training cases (same seed/settings) in node-local /tmp; its first five epochs must match the production baseline within 1e-5. A compact checkpoint is saved after a bitwise tensor comparison. The unchanged calibrator runs with `--max-cases 20 --seed 0`: **all 20 training cases** (below the frozen cap of 32); no validation case. λ = min(0.10·median(d)/median(b), 0.50·median(d)/q95(b)); the launcher recomputes it. Earlier weights are not reused. The production bands model starts from scratch.

## Execution and audits

One Slurm job (stud, one 4g.40gb slice, 6 CPUs, 64 GiB, 2 h limit; expected ≈12 min): snapshot verification, baseline, then bands (calibration source, calibration, production), each a separate bootstrapped process under `set -euo pipefail`. After bands, best and final checkpoints of both arms are evaluated in eval/no-grad AMP mode on identical unaugmented 20 training and 52 validation cases, then paired comparisons and `PAIR_SUMMARY.json`.

## Interpretation limits

Validation results (the validation set selects checkpoints and stopping); one model seed on one fixed subset; case IDs, not verified subjects. Cross-fraction comparisons also change update count per epoch. The 75-epoch cap does not establish convergence.

# Frozen protocol: no augmentation, folds 2 and 3

User request: one job per fold, each running three seeds of Dice baseline followed by three seeds of Dice plus boundary bands; queue fold 3 after fold 2.

## Cohorts

Original five-fold split SHA256: 1d6a3fe993359ad85e9c28a29901162251c3359449b710c09cb9e92d66dda472. Use actual zero-based trainer fold indices 2 and 3. For each fold, shuffle sorted original training case IDs using random.Random(0), then take floor(0.05 * 208) = 10 cases. Keep all 52 original validation cases. All model seeds within a fold share its fixed subset. The split JSON retains all five indices, with only the selected fold's training list reduced. Manifests freeze the exact case IDs and hashes before submission.

## Training

Separate fresh processes for baseline seeds 0, 1, 2; then band seeds 0, 1, 2. No augmentation and no translation augmentation. Dice supervision; all architecture, preprocessing, optimizer and StepLR settings match the completed fold-0 no-augmentation experiment. Maximum 75 epochs, minimum stopping epoch 60, patience 8, min_delta 0.0005. Band warmup five epochs, two-step balanced inner/outer BCE, gamma zero. No changes based on new-fold validation.

Each band weight is calibrated using the unchanged training-only gradient-ratio rule on that fold and model seed's ten cases. A dedicated five-epoch Dice-only calibration source must reproduce the first five epochs of its completed production baseline within 1e-5. Production band training starts from fresh initialization.

## Storage and provenance

Quota at preparation: 80.94/93.13 GiB; about 12.19 GiB remaining under mirrored accounting. Keep normal production best/latest checkpoints and model exports. Dedicated five-epoch calibration sources train in disposable node-local /tmp directories. Retain a compact checkpoint_latest.pt containing epoch, model tensors and embedded run provenance, plus config, metrics and derivation records. Reload and compare every model tensor bitwise before discarding the temporary full checkpoint. The unchanged calibrator validates and uses exactly these three fields; optimizer and resume state are not calibration inputs. Preserve the original temporary completion manifest with an explicit original_full_source filename. Existing experiments are untouched.

Expected persistent new checkpoint bytes: 12 * (2 * 196187565 + 70408385) + 6 * approximately 71 MB = approximately 5.57 GiB logical, 11.14 GiB quota. Allow additional space for metadata and one atomic checkpoint write; expected remaining headroom roughly 1 GiB. Calibration temporary checkpoints consume node-local storage instead of BeeGFS quota.

## Execution and audits

Frozen training source: ab972a098df39cbb874838a6e0009936a7497224db7bdf5c72eb427f3c433940. One 4g.40gb GPU slice, six CPUs, 64 GiB RAM, one-hour wall-time limit per fold. The shell stops on any failure. Fold 3 depends on successful completion of fold 2.

After each band run, evaluate best/final baseline and band checkpoints on identical clean training and validation cases. Validate cohort, checkpoint and input hashes. Save per-case Dice, calibration diagnostics, confusion matrices and paired comparisons. After all six runs, verify completion artifacts and write FOLD_SUMMARY.json and completion.json. Fold-specific audits pass the explicit expected fold index, eliminating the former fold-0 evaluator assumption.

Interpretation: seed robustness within each fixed fold/subset; training-only calibration; reused validation for checkpoint selection. Fold 2/3 are cross-fold checks, not untouched external tests. The 75-epoch cap does not establish full convergence.

# Fold-0 no-augmentation ablation

One matched seed-0 pair, trained from fresh initialization on the same fixed 5% subset (10 training cases, 52 validation cases). Both use 75 maximum epochs, early stopping from epoch 60, patience 8 and min_delta 0.0005. Disable mild_v1 augmentation and retain all other baseline settings, including Dice supervision, AdamW, StepLR(20, 0.5), batch 1, 64-cubed crop/pad, AMP, plain tensors and no activation checkpointing. No translation augmentation.

Run Dice baseline first. The band job depends on baseline success. Recreate a deterministic five-epoch no-augmentation baseline solely to supply the calibration checkpoint; verify its first five epochs against the completed no-augmentation baseline. Calibrate on all 10 training cases with augmentation disabled using the unchanged gradient-ratio calibration rule. Do not select or tune the weight using validation. Keep two-step balanced inner/outer boundary BCE, gamma 0 and five-epoch warmup. The production band model starts fresh and does not load the calibration checkpoint.

Use frozen source ab972a098df39cbb874838a6e0009936a7497224db7bdf5c72eb427f3c433940. Automatically audit best/final checkpoints and errors for the no-augmentation pair and both existing augmented seed-0 models. Write within-augmentation band comparisons, augmentation comparisons within each arm, and the descriptive difference between band gains. Different training-only calibrated weights mean this compares the calibrated method under each augmentation setting, rather than an identical numeric weight.

One exploratory seed and a repeatedly used validation fold. Fold-1 training is deferred until this ablation is reviewed. No full-data or extra-seed jobs are included.

# Seed-1 replication of the 5% augmented baseline/boundary-band pair

User requested both seed-1 runs to determine whether the seed-0 gain repeats.

## Fixed experimental choices

- Preserve exactly the same ten labelled training crops selected with subset seed 0 and the same 52 validation crops. This is training-seed replication on a fixed subset, not a second subset draw.
- Model/training seed 1; independent augmentation RNG seed 2. Both arms start fresh and use matched data order and mild_v1 augmentation draws.
- Baseline: Dice only. Candidate: Dice plus plain two-step inner/outer boundary-band BCE, focal gamma zero, five-epoch linear auxiliary warmup.
- The band-weight calibration rule is unchanged, but its value is recomputed from a fixed epoch-five seed-1 Dice checkpoint using only these ten training cases and their deterministic augmented views. Target median logit-gradient RMS is 10% of Dice, with the original 50% tail cap. No validation-based weight selection.
- Production budget and stopping unchanged: max50, min25, patience8, min_delta0.0005. Batch1, AdamW LR1e-4, weight decay1e-5, StepLR20 gamma0.5, no dropout, 64-cubed crop/pad, no resize, AMP, no activation checkpointing, plain tensors and zero workers.

## Execution

Two Slurm jobs use the same verified frozen source (ab972a098df39cbb874838a6e0009936a7497224db7bdf5c72eb427f3c433940). Baseline runs first; the band job has an afterok dependency on it. The band job includes the fixed five-epoch calibration source, exact first-five-epoch baseline parity check within 1e-5, calibration, a three-epoch fully active-band GPU smoke check, fresh production training, and automatic paired evaluation.

The seed-1 baseline uses the same source that already reproduced the seed-0 baseline exactly. No trainer, augmentation, Dice, band-loss, or early-stopping source is modified for this replication.

Production performs at most 500 updates per arm. Calibration and smoke runs are additional preparatory compute; their weights are never used to initialize production.

## Assessment

Compare seed-1 best versus best and final versus final on the same clean cohorts. Report validation Dice, foreground FP/FN, swaps, total errors, all per-case deltas and exploratory case-bootstrap intervals. Compare the direction and magnitude with seed0 (+4.85 pp best and +4.60 pp final). Do not claim independent test-set confirmation or subset robustness; validation is reused and the subset is held fixed.

No seed2, additional subset, architecture, or longer-budget run is authorized by this submission.

# Seed-2 replication of the 5% augmented baseline/boundary-band pair

User authorized the third training-seed pair to complete seeds 0, 1, 2 before robustness experiments across folds.

## Fixed design

- Fold 0; same ten labelled training cases selected with subset seed 0; same 52 validation cases. Model seed 2 and independent augmentation RNG seed 3; fresh initialization in both production arms.
- Baseline: supervised Dice. Bands: the same Dice plus balanced inner/outer boundary-band BCE, two six-neighbour steps, focal gamma 0, five-epoch linear warmup.
- Same training-only calibration rule at fixed baseline epoch 5: target 10% median logit-gradient RMS with 50% tail cap. Recompute the coefficient for this seed, without validation-based coefficient selection.
- Max 50 epochs, minimum 25, patience 8, minimum significant improvement 0.0005. Batch 1, AdamW LR 1e-4, weight decay 1e-5, StepLR step 20/gamma 0.5; mild_v1 augmentation; AMP; 64-cubed crop/pad, no resize, no dropout, no activation checkpointing, plain tensors, zero workers.
- Frozen training-source SHA256 ab972a098df39cbb874838a6e0009936a7497224db7bdf5c72eb427f3c433940. No training/loss changes. The evaluator only corrects the shared helper's previously hardcoded seed-0 interpretation text; numerical calculations are unchanged.

## Execution and safeguards

Baseline first; bands depends on successful baseline completion. Bands job reproduces five baseline epochs and checks metric parity, calibrates from training cases, runs the existing three-epoch active-loss preflight, then starts production from fresh seed 2 and audits best/final checkpoints for both arms. Calibration and preflight weights do not initialize production. Maximum 500 production updates per arm, plus preparatory compute.

All input/source/checkpoint provenance and ten/52 case counts are checked. New output directories are required; accidental restart or overwrite is refused. Automatic inference audit reports paired case Dice differences, FP/FN, A/P swaps and probability diagnostics.

## Interpretation and follow-up

The three-seed comparison estimates sensitivity to training randomness on this fixed subset, with reused validation; it is not three independent test cohorts. Report selected and final checkpoints separately and include matching-epoch results when stopping differs.

Different-fold experiments are the next proposed stage, not part of this submission. Lock method, calibration and training budget before inspecting new fold results. Use identical training subsets and RNG seeds within each baseline/bands pair; calibrate only within each fold's training data. Report paired gains per fold and seed, and do not treat overlapping cross-validation training sets as independent samples. New ten-case subset draws within a fold test a separate source of variability. A longer-budget baseline comparison remains useful to distinguish faster optimization from a persistent advantage.

# Signed face-contrast experiment

Requested after degree weighting failed to reduce boundary errors. Test the
proposed probability-space edge consistency on the existing network output;
no auxiliary head and no degree-dependent voxel weighting.

For whole hippocampus foreground y and p=p_A+p_P, penalize
`((p_i-p_j)-(y_i-y_j))**2` on face-adjacent pairs with **both** endpoints in
the union of the existing two-step inner and outer bands. Positive-axis faces
are counted once, with an unweighted mean over faces per case and an equal
mean over valid cases. GT geometry is recomputed after augmentation. Dice and
ordinary bands remain the base objective; degree weighting stays disabled.

Stage 1 is a training-only diagnostic, not another validation sweep. Use the
32 training cases and deterministic mild_v1 views already registered in the
degree-band calibration, with input, split and checkpoint hashes checked.
Calibrate edge lambda from the existing epoch-five Dice checkpoint to median
edge/base logit-gradient RMS ratio 0.1, capped at p95 ratio 0.5. Base means
Dice plus ordinary bands, retaining the historical bands coefficient exactly.
No new baseline or calibration-source training is performed.

At the existing converged early-stopped ordinary-bands checkpoint, measure
raw gradient norms, edge/base gradient cosine, first-order directions on
missed/extra foreground, and paired logit interventions. Update sizes 0.25
and 1.0 use the same base-gradient maximum for base and base+lambda*edge;
size 4.0 is a stress diagnostic only. All interventions are temporary tensor
calculations; no model parameters are changed.

Predeclared gate for a subsequent controlled training run:

- All gradients finite and nonzero; mean gradient cosine nonnegative.
- At both small steps, combined loss causes no increase over the base update
  in either pooled inner FN or outer FP, and no increase in total class errors.
- At least one small step strictly reduces pooled inner-FN plus outer-FP.

This is a conservative screening rule, not a proof that a failed candidate
could never help training, or that a passing candidate will generalize.
It specifically avoids accepting the missed-foreground/false-positive trade
observed with degree weighting. Failure stops promotion under this protocol;
do not switch loss formulations or tune lambda based on the outcome.

If it passes, train one seed-0 fold-0 Dice+ordinary-bands+edge model with the
existing augmentation and optimizer settings, using the same early stopping
(patience 8, minimum 25 epochs, delta 0.0005, maximum 50). Reuse the existing
Dice and Dice+bands controls, and assess paired boundary corrections on the
same validation cases. Record that the development fold has already been used.

# One augmented seed-0 plain boundary-band BCE pilot

User request: test the previously proposed band CE before further dropout exploration. Compare fresh mild_v1 augmentation + Dice + plain grouped outer-boundary BCE with the completed mild_v1 + Dice seed-0 baseline. Dropout stays zero; no A/P, focal, Tversky, teacher, ray or equivariance term.

The auxiliary groups anterior and posterior as hippocampal foreground. Build inner and outer bands using two six-neighbor morphological steps on the current transformed label. Average BCE within each side, balance the two sides equally and average valid patients. The three-class Dice term still supervises the A/P labels. This is targeted boundary supervision, not a new anatomical prior.

Keep fold 0, 208/52 cases, batch 1, 64³, no resize, AdamW explicit weight decay 1e-5, LR 1e-4, StepLR 20/gamma 0.5, AMP, plain tensors, zero workers and no activation checkpointing. Maximum 50 epochs; minimum 25, patience 8 and minimum improvement 0.0005. Five-epoch linear auxiliary warmup. One forward and one combined backward per training batch.

Within the single Slurm job, first train a matched five-epoch augmented Dice control from scratch. Calibrate on its final epoch-five checkpoint, never selected by validation. Use 32 deterministic training-only cases with the same mild_v1 implementation and seed+1 augmentation generator. Target auxiliary median logit-gradient RMS at 10% of Dice; retain the 50% tail cap. Bind the calibration to augmentation policy, RNG seed, input and split hashes, preprocessing, source, runtime, device and source checkpoint. The production run starts from scratch and does not load the calibration checkpoint.

Before production, compare baseline/candidate/candidate/baseline three-epoch timing blocks, discarding each first epoch. Require ≤5% median overhead in both training and total epoch time, ≤1.15 maximum measured epoch ratio, exact expected forward counts, and baseline first-three-epoch parity within 1e-5. Record the separate calibration-source and calibration costs. Keep the calibration checkpoint, but hash and remove disposable timing checkpoints after each block, retaining logs, metrics and cleanup records. Failure prevents production.

After stopping, verify artifact hashes and audit both selected and final checkpoints against the original augmented baseline on all clean training and validation cases. Export per-case confusion matrices, Dice, total errors, foreground FP/FN, both A/P swap directions and boundary/calibration statistics, with paired case-bootstrap intervals. Interpret seed-0 results as exploratory; inspect overall performance rather than the train–validation gap alone. A practical pilot target is +0.2 percentage points validation Dice with fewer total errors and no substantial class or lower-tail regression, supported by both checkpoint policies; this is not a significance test.

Submit only this one experiment, keep the existing A/P follow-up on hold and never exceed two queued/running jobs. Check BeeGFS quota before submission. Do not promote a new baseline without replication.

## Throughput retry

Attempt 660468 stopped before production at the strict runtime gate: +5.70% total-epoch and +7.10% training overhead, with exact baseline parity. Attempt 02 consolidates repeated valid-row filtering inside the band loss, preserving its reductions and gradients. It includes an old/new GPU loss-and-gradient parity check and isolated profiler, then repeats calibration and the unchanged full-epoch runtime gate. No statistical settings or thresholds are changed.

Attempt 660475 also stopped before production (+5.89% epoch, +7.35% training overhead), despite a 14% isolated auxiliary speedup. Attempt 03 additionally uses the algebraically equivalent logaddexp for the canonical two-foreground/one-background grouping and skips sum kernels on singleton diagnostic tensors. GPU numerical and full-epoch gates remain unchanged.

Attempt 660489 met the epoch limit (+4.57%) but failed training-only (+5.78%). Attempt 04 caches the immutable per-device morphology kernel and combines the six equivalent face-touch reductions. Geometry, loss, calibration and acceptance thresholds remain unchanged.

# Dice-only baseline with validation early stopping

User-authorized submission: fold 0, seed 0, from-scratch Dice-only SwinUNETR.

## Fixed training settings

- MSD Task04, canonical 208 training / 52 validation split, 64³ inputs, no resize.
- Batch size 1; no translation augmentation or auxiliary constraint; AMP enabled.
- AdamW: learning rate 1e-4, weight decay 1e-5; StepLR every 20 epochs, factor 0.5.
- Maximum 50 epochs. Validation hard foreground Dice every epoch.
- Patience 8, significant improvement strictly greater than 0.0005 over the last
  significant reference score; earliest stop epoch 25.
- Best checkpoint uses every strict improvement in raw validation hard Dice,
  including improvements smaller than the patience threshold.
- At termination, export and evaluate the best checkpoint. Preserve latest
  weights/optimizer/scheduler/RNG at the stopping epoch for reproducible resume.
- Replay durable metric history on resume to recover the stopping state. If a
  stopped run resumes, finalize/evaluate it without any new optimizer updates.
- Existing validation confidence diagnostics enabled; W&B disabled as in the
  historical matched baseline. No NLL-based selection rule is added.

## Evaluation and interpretation

After training, evaluate the new best/latest and the historical matched seed-0
baseline best/latest on the identical 208 training and 52 validation cases.
Record the same supervised Dice loss, foreground soft/hard Dice, confusion counts,
NLL/Brier/ECE, error confidence, and per-case metrics for both cohorts. The new
best versus historical best comparison tests reproducibility; the new best versus
historical epoch 50 comparison quantifies checkpoint-selection benefit.

Early stopping does not change optimizer updates before termination. If trajectories
match, expect the historical epoch-16 model selected around stopping epoch 25.
The baseline has been inspected repeatedly on fold 0; this rerun does not constitute
independent evidence of improved generalization to a new fold.

## Artifacts

- Frozen source and file-level manifest in the dedicated cluster experiment root.
- `runs/dice_early_stopping_fold0_seed0/metrics.csv`, best/latest checkpoints,
  `final_metrics.json`, `completion_manifest.json`, and selected `MSD_fold0/model.pt`.
- `generalization_audit/`: separate JSONs for four checkpoint/cohort comparisons,
  with checkpoint/data/config hashes and an aggregate `summary.json`.
- `SUBMISSION.json`: job identity and verified submission parameters.

## Checks before submission

The stopping controller and trainer are covered by tests for accumulated small
improvements, minimum epoch, disabled behavior, interruption/resume, early-stop
finalization, restoring a raw best smaller than min_delta, and rejection of changed
resume settings. Existing follow-up training tests cover unchanged default paths.
The audit evaluator is checked against perfect and confidently wrong synthetic logits.

# Five-percent augmented boundary-band pilot, seed 0

User authorized trying the recommended ordinary boundary-band BCE after the low-data error audit.

Submit one Slurm job. Keep the exact ten training cases and 52 validation cases from completed job 661170. Use mild_v1, Dice plus plain two-step inner/outer band BCE, focal gamma zero, batch one, seed zero, no dropout, no other constraints. The production model starts fresh with the same initialization and independent augmentation RNG as the baseline.

Reuse the verified frozen source of the previous successful augmented-band experiment, source digest ab972a098df39cbb874838a6e0009936a7497224db7bdf5c72eb427f3c433940. Preserve the old source and all completed experiments. Verify an exact copy before and after execution.

Calibration: a fixed five-epoch Dice-only run on the ten-case subset; its latest checkpoint is selected by epoch, not validation. Verify its first-five-epoch losses and Dice against the existing baseline within 1e-5. Calibrate on all ten training cases with deterministic mild_v1 views, target median band-gradient RMS 10% of Dice and existing 50% tail cap. Do not use the full-data model, the excluded 198 training labels, or validation labels to fit the coefficient.

GPU preflight: three fresh epochs with the calibrated band loss fully active, verify finite losses, nonzero auxiliary, and exactly 30 training plus 208 evaluation forwards. This disposable run is not the production initialization. Record runtime; the unchanged core implementation already passed full-data performance gates.

Production: maximum 50 epochs, early stopping minimum 25, patience 8, min_delta 0.0005; five-epoch linear auxiliary warmup. AdamW LR 1e-4, weight decay 1e-5, StepLR20 gamma0.5, 64-cubed crop/pad, no resize, AMP, plain tensors, no activation checkpointing, zero workers. One model forward and one combined backward per training batch.

After completion, automatically compare both best and final checkpoints to job 661170 on clean ten-case training and 52-case validation cohorts. Record Dice, foreground FP/FN, both A/P swap directions, calibration, and paired exploratory case-bootstrap intervals.

Interpretation: this tests an auxiliary under the same short 500-update ceiling as the baseline. It does not establish label efficiency independently of optimization time, anatomical novelty, or generalization to an untouched test set. No additional architecture, CE-control, or longer-budget training experiment is included.

# Longer-budget 5% augmented seed-0 baseline

User authorized one fresh baseline training run to test whether extending training reduces the observed boundary-band advantage.

## Fixed choices

- Original fold 0, same ten labelled cases (subset seed 0), same 52 validation cases.
- Fresh model seed 0; augmentation RNG seed 1; mild_v1 augmentation; Dice-only objective.
- Same AdamW, LR 1e-4, weight decay 1e-5, StepLR every 20 epochs with gamma 0.5. Continue the schedule through epoch 75; do not reset or stretch it. Thus the nominal learning rate drops again after epoch 60.
- Batch 1, 64-cubed crop/pad, no resize, no dropout, AMP, plain tensors, no activation checkpointing, zero workers.
- Change maximum epochs from 50 to 75 and minimum early-stopping epoch from 25 to 60. Preserve patience 8 and minimum significant validation-Dice improvement 0.0005. Earliest possible stop is epoch 60; latest is 75. Best checkpoint can still come from an earlier epoch.
- At most 750 optimizer updates. This is a fresh run, not a resume or warm start from the old checkpoint.
- Frozen source ab972a098df39cbb874838a6e0009936a7497224db7bdf5c72eb427f3c433940, used by the verified seed-0 band experiment and seed-1/2 pair replications. No trainer or loss edits. The original seed-0 baseline used source 79d59655; the later snapshot previously reproduced its five-epoch calibration control. Compare the full first-50-epoch trajectory again to expose any difference.

## Audit

Verify the source snapshot and exact launch-file hashes before training. Preserve the original runs. After training, compare first-50-epoch supervised loss, validation hard/soft Dice and LR against the original seed-0 baseline (report maximum differences, tolerance 1e-5). Re-evaluate best and final checkpoints of the extended baseline, original 50-epoch baseline, and original 50-epoch bands on clean training/validation cohorts. Save all paired case-level comparisons and error/calibration diagnostics.

This job trains only the new baseline. The old runs receive inference only. The comparison tests whether this baseline catches up within the extended schedule; stopping or reaching the cap does not by itself establish optimization convergence. It is a one-seed follow-up on reused validation, with a longer checkpoint-selection opportunity. No fold-1 or extended-band training is included.

# Frozen protocol: 200-epoch stretched-schedule control, 10 cases (5%), fold 0, model seed 0

User request (18 September 2026): train the original 5% fold-0 seed-0 baseline and bands pair for 200 epochs to test the working hypothesis that much of the 10-case bands gain is faster progress within a limited update budget. The user chose a proportionally stretched LR schedule and a full 200-epoch run, submitted as a single job with both arms.

## Cohort

Identical to the original 10-case pair: fold 0, the existing split file `low_data_5pct_augmented_seed0_20260917/splits_5pct_seed0.json` (SHA256 7b69e54d…ce8be, reused read-only by path), 10 training cases and the original 52 validation cases.

## What changes and what does not

| Setting | Original 10-case pair | This control |
|---|---|---|
| Maximum epochs | 75 | **200** |
| StepLR step (epochs), gamma 0.5 | 20 | **53** (= 20 × 200/75, rounded) |
| Earliest stopping epoch | 60 | **200** (all epochs run) |
| LR by epoch | 1e-4, 5e-5, 2.5e-5, 1.25e-5 from epochs 1/21/41/61 | same four values from epochs 1/54/107/160 |

Everything else is unchanged and frozen (source ab972a098df39cbb874838a6e0009936a7497224db7bdf5c72eb427f3c433940): SwinUNETR, preprocessing, no augmentation, Dice incl. background, AdamW LR 1e-4 / weight decay 1e-5, batch 1, AMP, seed 0, fresh initialization for both arms, patience 8 / min_delta 0.0005 (inactive before 200), best checkpoint = maximum validation hard Dice. Bands: γ=0, two six-neighbour steps, warmup min(e/5,1).

Keeping step 20 would add only ~8% learning-rate budget, since LR would be ≤1.25e-5 after epoch 60. The stretched schedule gives ~2.65× the original budget (LR summed over updates: 979 versus 369 initial-LR units; the 26-case pilot used 910, the 52-case 1,820). Epochs 1–20 have the same LR as the original run, so those epochs are expected to reproduce it.

## Calibration

A fresh five-epoch Dice-only source on all 10 cases (node-local /tmp), with a first-five-epoch parity check (1e-5) against the new baseline, a compact checkpoint and the unchanged calibrator `--max-cases 10 --seed 0` (all 10 cases, no validation). The first five epochs do not depend on the step size, so λ is expected to reproduce the original 0.0021935515; it is recomputed rather than reused.

## Execution

One Slurm job (stud, one 4g.40gb slice, 6 CPUs, 64 GiB, 2 h limit; ≈30 min): snapshot verification, baseline, bands (calibration source, calibration, production), then best/final evaluation of both arms on identical 10 training / 52 validation cases, paired comparisons and `PAIR_SUMMARY.json`.

## Interpretation limits

One seed on one fold; validation reused for selection. The stretched schedule changes the update budget and the timing of LR drops relative to the original pair, so this tests the combined effect of longer training at a matching LR shape, not an infinitely long run. It is a new experiment, not a replacement for the established four-fold result.

# Frozen protocol: no augmentation, folds 2 and 3

User request: one job per fold, each running three seeds of Dice baseline followed by three seeds of Dice plus boundary bands; queue fold 3 after fold 2.

## Cohorts

Original five-fold split SHA256: 1d6a3fe993359ad85e9c28a29901162251c3359449b710c09cb9e92d66dda472. Use actual zero-based trainer fold indices 2 and 3. For each fold, shuffle sorted original training case IDs using random.Random(0), then take floor(0.05 * 208) = 10 cases. Keep all 52 original validation cases. All model seeds within a fold share its fixed subset. The split JSON retains all five indices, with only the selected fold's training list reduced. Manifests freeze the exact case IDs and hashes before submission.

## Training

Separate fresh processes for baseline seeds 0, 1, 2; then band seeds 0, 1, 2. No augmentation and no translation augmentation. Dice supervision; all architecture, preprocessing, optimizer and StepLR settings match the completed fold-0 no-augmentation experiment. Maximum 75 epochs, minimum stopping epoch 60, patience 8, min_delta 0.0005. Band warmup five epochs, two-step balanced inner/outer BCE, gamma zero. No changes based on new-fold validation.

Each band weight is calibrated using the unchanged training-only gradient-ratio rule on that fold and model seed's ten cases. A dedicated five-epoch Dice-only calibration source must reproduce the first five epochs of its completed production baseline within 1e-5. Production band training starts from fresh initialization.

## Storage and provenance

Quota at preparation: 80.94/93.13 GiB; about 12.19 GiB remaining under mirrored accounting. Keep normal production best/latest checkpoints and model exports. Dedicated five-epoch calibration sources train in disposable node-local /tmp directories. Retain a compact checkpoint_latest.pt containing epoch, model tensors and embedded run provenance, plus config, metrics and derivation records. Reload and compare every model tensor bitwise before discarding the temporary full checkpoint. The unchanged calibrator validates and uses exactly these three fields; optimizer and resume state are not calibration inputs. Preserve the original temporary completion manifest with an explicit original_full_source filename. Existing experiments are untouched.

Expected persistent new checkpoint bytes: 12 * (2 * 196187565 + 70408385) + 6 * approximately 71 MB = approximately 5.57 GiB logical, 11.14 GiB quota. Allow additional space for metadata and one atomic checkpoint write; expected remaining headroom roughly 1 GiB. Calibration temporary checkpoints consume node-local storage instead of BeeGFS quota.

## Execution and audits

Frozen training source: ab972a098df39cbb874838a6e0009936a7497224db7bdf5c72eb427f3c433940. One 4g.40gb GPU slice, six CPUs, 64 GiB RAM, one-hour wall-time limit per fold. The shell stops on any failure. Fold 3 depends on successful completion of fold 2.

After each band run, evaluate best/final baseline and band checkpoints on identical clean training and validation cases. Validate cohort, checkpoint and input hashes. Save per-case Dice, calibration diagnostics, confusion matrices and paired comparisons. After all six runs, verify completion artifacts and write FOLD_SUMMARY.json and completion.json. Fold-specific audits pass the explicit expected fold index, eliminating the former fold-0 evaluator assumption.

Interpretation: seed robustness within each fixed fold/subset; training-only calibration; reused validation for checkpoint selection. Fold 2/3 are cross-fold checks, not untouched external tests. The 75-epoch cap does not establish full convergence.

One matched seed-0 pair, trained from fresh initialization on the same fixed 5% subset (10 training cases, 52 validation cases). # Seed-1 replication of the 5% augmented baseline/boundary-band pair

User requested both seed-1 runs to determine whether the seed-0 gain repeats.

## Fixed experimental choices

- Preserve exactly the same ten labelled training crops selected with subset seed 0 and the same 52 validation crops. This is training-seed replication on a fixed subset, not a second subset draw.
- Model/training seed 1; independent augmentation RNG seed 2. Both arms start fresh and use matched data order and mild_v1 augmentation draws.
- Baseline: Dice only. Candidate: Dice plus plain two-step inner/outer boundary-band BCE, focal gamma zero, five-epoch linear auxiliary warmup.
- The band-weight calibration rule is unchanged, but its value is recomputed from a fixed epoch-five seed-1 Dice checkpoint using only these ten training cases and their deterministic augmented views. Target median logit-gradient RMS is 10% of Dice, with the original 50% tail cap. No validation-based weight selection.
- Production budget and stopping unchanged: max50, min25, patience8, min_delta0.0005. Batch1, AdamW LR1e-4, weight decay1e-5, StepLR20 gamma0.5, no dropout, 64-cubed crop/pad, no resize, AMP, no activation checkpointing, plain tensors and zero workers.

## Execution

Two Slurm jobs use the same verified frozen source (ab972a098df39cbb874838a6e0009936a7497224db7bdf5c72eb427f3c433940). Baseline runs first; the band job has an afterok dependency on it. The band job includes the fixed five-epoch calibration source, exact first-five-epoch baseline parity check within 1e-5, calibration, a three-epoch fully active-band GPU smoke check, fresh production training, and automatic paired evaluation.

The seed-1 baseline uses the same source that already reproduced the seed-0 baseline exactly. No trainer, augmentation, Dice, band-loss, or early-stopping source is modified for this replication.

Production performs at most 500 updates per arm. Calibration and smoke runs are additional preparatory compute; their weights are never used to initialize production.

## Assessment

Compare seed-1 best versus best and final versus final on the same clean cohorts. Report validation Dice, foreground FP/FN, swaps, total errors, all per-case deltas and exploratory case-bootstrap intervals. Compare the direction and magnitude with seed0 (+4.85 pp best and +4.60 pp final). Do not claim independent test-set confirmation or subset robustness; validation is reused and the subset is held fixed.

No seed2, additional subset, architecture, or longer-budget run is authorized by this submission.

# Seed-2 replication of the 5% augmented baseline/boundary-band pair

User authorized the third training-seed pair to complete seeds 0, 1, 2 before robustness experiments across folds.

## Fixed design

- Fold 0; same ten labelled training cases selected with subset seed 0; same 52 validation cases. Model seed 2 and independent augmentation RNG seed 3; fresh initialization in both production arms.
- Baseline: supervised Dice. Bands: the same Dice plus balanced inner/outer boundary-band BCE, two six-neighbour steps, focal gamma 0, five-epoch linear warmup.
- Same training-only calibration rule at fixed baseline epoch 5: target 10% median logit-gradient RMS with 50% tail cap. Recompute the coefficient for this seed, without validation-based coefficient selection.
- Max 50 epochs, minimum 25, patience 8, minimum significant improvement 0.0005. Batch 1, AdamW LR 1e-4, weight decay 1e-5, StepLR step 20/gamma 0.5; mild_v1 augmentation; AMP; 64-cubed crop/pad, no resize, no dropout, no activation checkpointing, plain tensors, zero workers.
- Frozen training-source SHA256 ab972a098df39cbb874838a6e0009936a7497224db7bdf5c72eb427f3c433940. No training/loss changes. The evaluator only corrects the shared helper's previously hardcoded seed-0 interpretation text; numerical calculations are unchanged.

## Execution and safeguards

Baseline first; bands depends on successful baseline completion. Bands job reproduces five baseline epochs and checks metric parity, calibrates from training cases, runs the existing three-epoch active-loss preflight, then starts production from fresh seed 2 and audits best/final checkpoints for both arms. Calibration and preflight weights do not initialize production. Maximum 500 production updates per arm, plus preparatory compute.

All input/source/checkpoint provenance and ten/52 case counts are checked. New output directories are required; accidental restart or overwrite is refused. Automatic inference audit reports paired case Dice differences, FP/FN, A/P swaps and probability diagnostics.

## Interpretation and follow-up

The three-seed comparison estimates sensitivity to training randomness on this fixed subset, with reused validation; it is not three independent test cohorts. Report selected and final checkpoints separately and include matching-epoch results when stopping differs.

Different-fold experiments are the next proposed stage, not part of this submission. Lock method, calibration and training budget before inspecting new fold results. Use identical training subsets and RNG seeds within each baseline/bands pair; calibrate only within each fold's training data. Report paired gains per fold and seed, and do not treat overlapping cross-validation training sets as independent samples. New ten-case subset draws within a fold test a separate source of variability. A longer-budget baseline comparison remains useful to distinguish faster optimization from a persistent advantage.

# Scalar-presence feasibility diagnostic

Added after the first component fold showed that setting true-thin presence to
one recovers correct anatomy but adds FP voxels within occupied rays. This is a
post-hoc mechanistic follow-up, not a modification of the already running
capacity/pooling experiment or its selection rules.

Question: can ANY increase of a ray's scalar presence recover its true thin
voxels without also activating wrong voxels, with raw logits and fitted edges
fixed? A larger classifier cannot overcome an infeasible per-ray ordering.

On every true thin ray, find the smallest increase of log presence that achieves
(a) at least one correct foreground voxel, and separately (b) every true
foreground voxel. Use 24 vectorized bisection steps between original log
presence and zero (presence one); only attempt rays for which presence one can
achieve the endpoint. Leave all other rays exactly unchanged. Ray endpoints
are monotone because the foreground margin increases monotonically with
presence and anterior/posterior logits stay unchanged.

Report target rays, feasible rays, recovered correct voxels, additional FP
voxels on those same rays, number of recoveries with zero extra FP voxels,
whole-mask ASSD/overlap, and distribution of required presence. Validate the
bisection endpoints and guarantee that empty rays are bitwise unchanged.
Count residual unrecoverable cases separately. All variants use reference
labels and are non-deployable. This measures conditional representational
feasibility, not whether a learned network can choose these values or achieve
the outcome on new data.

The minimum required presence need not be a calibrated existence probability.
If near-one classification induces overshoot but minimal increases avoid it,
decoupling existence probability from correction strength is a more specific
next hypothesis than simply widening the head.

# Presence mechanism: frozen development experiments

Status: specified before new checkpoint inference or training. These are internal
mechanism experiments on the reused MSD pool, not independent confirmation.
Existing A/D/E checkpoints and historical reports must never be overwritten.

## Stage 1: component interventions and surface attribution

Evaluate all 208 outer cases from folds 1–4 using saved A and E checkpoints.
Verify each checkpoint against its done.json hash, dataset/split hashes, and
reproduce the saved case-level ASSD before accepting any new results.

Prespecified E interventions: raw output; original renderer; oracle presence in
the renderer only with fitted edges fixed; oracle edges on true rays with
presence fixed; both; oracle presence in the fit only; oracle presence in fit
and renderer; unit presence only on true thin rays; edge distribution moments
without fitting; interval-distance occupancy with all predictions fixed; restore
raw masks on erased true thin rays; reference-mask replacement on missed thin,
missed thicker, empty false-positive, and present-but-wrong true rays separately.
Every intervention using reference labels is explicitly non-deployable.

Primary mechanistic outcomes: correctly overlapping thin-ray recall, thin voxel
recall, and directional ASSD contributions. Ray presence alone is insufficient.
Record empty-ray FPs, FP voxels/components, signed volume error, class/union Dice,
HD95, all-present and conditional edge MAE, and raw/rendered decision margins.
Thin means a contiguous reference interval of span 1 or 2; two disconnected
voxels are multi-run, not thin. Report border rays separately.

Partition surface contributions into empty, thin length 1, thin length 2,
length 3–5, length >=6, multi-run, and border rays. Subdivide true rays using
the original E final presence decision, fixed for every compared output.
Contributions use each method's own prediction-surface denominator and the
common reference-surface denominator, and must sum to its original ASSD.
Also report fixed-reference coverage at 0, 1, and 2 mm. Counterfactual effects
are nonadditive; they are not achievable bounds or proof of learnability.

## Stage 2: capacity versus pooling, conditional on the saved E representation

Four arms form a 2x2 comparison: width 24 or 48, with duplicated-mean pooling
or mean-plus-max pooling. Every arm is a dedicated trainable presence stem
cloned from E; the backbone, feature projection, edge distributions, fitted
edges, renderer temperature, and beta remain frozen. Presence changes only the
renderer. Thus this stage isolates classification from geometry co-adaptation.

The presence output convolution receives 2*width channels in every arm. Its
first half is initialized from E; the second half is zero. The mean control
duplicates the mean features, matching parameter count to mean-plus-max.
Width 48 uses function-preserving channel duplication with cancelling output
perturbations to break duplicate-channel gradient symmetry. Assert identical
initial presence and final masks for all arms against E.

Train all arms for 12 epochs, AdamW lr=1e-4, weight_decay=1e-5, batch size one
volume. Seeds 0, 1, 2 determine paired case order and symmetry-breaking noise.
Use E's 166 fitting cases; its 42 inner cases select checkpoints; the 52 outer
cases are processed only after all arm/seed selections for that fold are fixed.
The fitting data previously trained E: this is explicitly conditional on E and
may contain in-sample feature optimism. These are presence-training seeds, not
independent backbone-training seeds.

Loss: equal mean BCE over four nonempty groups per case: true thin rays,
other true rays, hard empty rays, and other empty rays. Hard empty means raw E
has any positive argmax voxel OR original E head presence >=0.5. All empty rays
receive supervision. Freeze groups from original E/reference labels; no outer
label-dependent feature construction or selection. No focal-weight grid.

At epochs 0, 4, 8, 12, evaluate unshifted head probabilities and the prespecified
presence-logit offsets -1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1 on inner validation only. Include
unchanged E as a fallback. Select maximum case-mean correctly overlapping
thin-ray recall subject to mean FP rays and total FP voxels <= E, mean thin
voxel recall >= E, and ASSD <= E+0.002 mm. Break ties by lower ASSD, then lower
FP rays, earlier epoch, smaller absolute offset. The 0.002 mm margin is a
development guard, not a clinical noninferiority margin. Also save unconstrained
training/inner losses and epoch-zero metrics to distinguish optimization
failure, overfitting, and failure of the operating constraint.

Report selected and final uncalibrated heads, not just fallback-selected output.
Primary contrasts are width48-minus-width24 within each pooling strategy and
max-minus-mean at each width. Report all folds/seeds, paired case changes after
averaging seeds, and seed-to-seed variability separately. Do not count seeds or
rays as independent patients. A null result is evidence about this intervention,
not a proof that arbitrary larger end-to-end heads cannot help.

## Decision rules and next stage

If oracle renderer presence does not restore correct thin anatomy, do not
interpret more capacity as the primary remedy. If it restores anatomy but
larger heads do not improve held-out FP-matched preservation, capacity at these
widths is unsupported. A pooling advantage with no width advantage favors an
evidence-aggregation bottleneck. Improvements confined to fitting cases favor
overfitting; universal no-op selection requires inspecting unselected metrics.

Only a clear capacity/pooling improvement proceeds to matched end-to-end
training with independent backbone seeds. A separate three-arm gradient study
(D-prime, rendered loss with detached geometry, full E) remains a subsequent
experiment; this frozen-head study cannot answer that question.

No automatic promotion, external generalization claim, clinical claim, pruning
of previous checkpoints, or modification of historical primary results.

## Reproduction amendment before component results were available

Job 666639 stopped at the 1e-4 mm case-level reproduction guard on fold 1,
hippocampus_166. The original record is 0.3497679963 mm; multiple existing
read-only re-evaluations give 0.3504276702 mm. REFERENCE_E.csv is frozen from
the previously saved raw-thin-rescue baseline, with source/hash in its provenance
JSON. The rerun checks E against this previously recorded re-evaluation at the
same 1e-4 tolerance and records BOTH old and repeated references. A is still
checked against the original record. All treatment comparisons use the current
paired baseline. This is a reproducibility amendment, not a changed scientific
endpoint, selection rule, or intervention. A repeated-inference diagnostic also
compares the old evaluator with the new metric code on the affected case.

## Exact-initialization amendment before any new-head outer evaluation

Job 666653 passed the small-head run but stopped at the wide-head initial
equivalence gate: GPU convolution rounding produced up to 0.00178 presence-logit
differences despite algebraically preserving the function. No new-head outer
cases had been evaluated. All arms are restarted using
`cached_E_logit + (trainable_branch(input) - frozen_initial_branch(input))`.
The two branches initially have identical parameters/operations, so their
difference is exactly zero. Cancelling channel perturbations still break
gradient symmetry in the widened trainable branch. Frozen initial parameters
are excluded from optimization and reported trainable parameter counts. This
changes numerical initialization, not the training data, objective, selections,
or factorial contrasts; the stopped run remains recorded and is not reused.

# Frozen E: remove presence only from rendering

Written before execution. User requested the proposed single mechanism test.
Use saved E on the same 208 internal outer cases, folds 1–4, 52 cases per fold.
No fitting, tuning, selection, new cohort claim or additional seed runs.

Run E once per case. Reuse its raw logits, fitted lower/upper boundaries, beta,
tau=0.5 and product-renderer implementation. Replace only log presence in the
renderer with exactly zero (presence exactly one). Do not refit boundaries,
change smoothing, alter the head or update parameters. Geometry retains the
historical influence of presence through the fit. This tests the explicit
rendering multiplier, not a model trained without a presence branch.

Primary diagnostics: restoration of raw-detected true thin rays deleted by E,
restoration of true overlap, and additional FP rays/voxels. Count ray presence
and true overlap separately. Report standard nonborder span<=2 thin definition
and an additional count-of-true-voxels 1–2 definition. Do not silently compare
denominators with earlier reports. Secondary: union and per-class Dice, ASSD,
HD95, true voxel recoveries, FN counts, and case/fold heterogeneity. Bootstrap
case differences conditional on fitted models; reused development labels limit
interpretation. No intervention selection on these results.

For remaining true rays without overlap, partition into: raw true overlap existed
(geometry suppresses it even at presence one); no raw true overlap but positive
geometric foreground correction on some true voxel; no raw true overlap and no
positive correction on any true voxel. These are endpoint descriptions, not
independent causal effects of geometry versus raw logits. The last two can have
joint deficits. Labels are used only for metrics and attribution.

Check original renderer exact reproduction, historical E metric reproduction,
unchanged foreground logits/classes, monotone foreground masks when presence
increases, unchanged checkpoints, source/data hashes, and complete nonduplicated
case coverage. Tests cover one-voxel rescue, residual geometric suppression,
label-independent intervention, and false presence versus actual overlap.
Store individual records only on the cluster. Export only aggregate reports
under the user's standing authorization for this investigation.

# Dice-only baseline with validation early stopping

User-authorized submission: fold 0, seed 0, from-scratch Dice-only SwinUNETR.

## Fixed training settings

- MSD Task04, canonical 208 training / 52 validation split, 64³ inputs, no resize.
- Batch size 1; no translation augmentation or auxiliary constraint; AMP enabled.
- AdamW: learning rate 1e-4, weight decay 1e-5; StepLR every 20 epochs, factor 0.5.
- Maximum 50 epochs. Validation hard foreground Dice every epoch.
- Patience 8, significant improvement strictly greater than 0.0005 over the last
  significant reference score; earliest stop epoch 25.
- Best checkpoint uses every strict improvement in raw validation hard Dice,
  including improvements smaller than the patience threshold.
- At termination, export and evaluate the best checkpoint. Preserve latest
  weights/optimizer/scheduler/RNG at the stopping epoch for reproducible resume.
- Replay durable metric history on resume to recover the stopping state. If a
  stopped run resumes, finalize/evaluate it without any new optimizer updates.
- Existing validation confidence diagnostics enabled; W&B disabled as in the
  historical matched baseline. No NLL-based selection rule is added.

## Evaluation and interpretation

After training, evaluate the new best/latest and the historical matched seed-0
baseline best/latest on the identical 208 training and 52 validation cases.
Record the same supervised Dice loss, foreground soft/hard Dice, confusion counts,
NLL/Brier/ECE, error confidence, and per-case metrics for both cohorts. The new
best versus historical best comparison tests reproducibility; the new best versus
historical epoch 50 comparison quantifies checkpoint-selection benefit.

Early stopping does not change optimizer updates before termination. If trajectories
match, expect the historical epoch-16 model selected around stopping epoch 25.
The baseline has been inspected repeatedly on fold 0; this rerun does not constitute
independent evidence of improved generalization to a new fold.

## Artifacts

- Frozen source and file-level manifest in the dedicated cluster experiment root.
- `runs/dice_early_stopping_fold0_seed0/metrics.csv`, best/latest checkpoints,
  `final_metrics.json`, `completion_manifest.json`, and selected `MSD_fold0/model.pt`.
- `generalization_audit/`: separate JSONs for four checkpoint/cohort comparisons,
  with checkpoint/data/config hashes and an aggregate `summary.json`.
- `SUBMISSION.json`: job identity and verified submission parameters.

## Checks before submission

The stopping controller and trainer are covered by tests for accumulated small
improvements, minimum epoch, disabled behavior, interruption/resume, early-stop
finalization, restoring a raw best smaller than min_delta, and rejection of changed
resume settings. Existing follow-up training tests cover unchanged default paths.
The audit evaluator is checked against perfect and confidently wrong synthetic logits.

# Regularization exploration, round 1

The user authorized two exploratory runs after the execution speedup. These are
fresh fold-0/seed-0 runs, compared with completed baseline 660226. This round
screens two hypotheses; it does not establish a robust baseline across seeds.

| Arm | Training augmentation | AdamW weight decay | Dropout |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| Existing baseline | None | 1e-5 | 0 |
| Augmentation | mild_v1, one view per case | 1e-5 | 0 |
| Weight decay | None | 1e-2 | 0 |

Both preserve 208/52 cases, 64-cubed inputs, Dice loss, batch size 1, AdamW
learning rate 1e-4, StepLR 20/0.5, AMP, validation every epoch, best raw validation
Dice checkpoint selection, and early stopping (patience 8, delta 0.0005, minimum
25 epochs, maximum 50). Plain tensors and disabled activation checkpointing
retain the verified execution improvements. No new anatomical loss is used.

mild_v1 has a 20% explicit identity probability. Otherwise it independently
applies: affine with probability 0.7 (rotation ±10 degrees per axis, isotropic
scale 0.9–1.1, translation ±2 voxels per axis); contrast scaling with probability
0.5 (factor 0.9–1.1); Gaussian noise with probability 0.15 (standard deviation
0.01–0.03 in normalized image units); Gaussian blur with probability 0.15
(sigma 0.3–0.7 voxels). No reflections or elastic deformations. Image affine
interpolation is trilinear; labels use nearest neighbor. Transform proposals
are rejected if the transformed foreground bounding box would leave the volume
or a label class disappears. Normal volume changes from resampling/scaling are
not treated as clipping. Intensity operations use image support, never a label
mask. The policy is recorded in config.json and versioned source.

All sampling uses the existing checkpointed independent CPU augmentation RNG;
model and data-order RNG streams are untouched. Validation and final audits
always use identity inputs. Tests cover alignment, clipping, class preservation,
input immutability, random-stream isolation and bitwise CPU interrupted/resumed
training. Each job must finish a separate full-data CUDA smoke epoch before
production training. The augmentation job additionally audits one augmented
pass over all training cases. Smoke runs reset seeds and have separate outputs.

Only these two new training jobs are submitted in this round, sequentially
under the account's one-running-job limit. The second job audits baseline and
both candidates' best/latest checkpoints, including train/validation Dice,
normalized A/P swaps, foreground false positives/negatives, calibration, and
paired per-case comparisons. The evaluator reuses cohort/model allocation and
the training process to avoid repeated heavy import startup.

A useful candidate must improve held-out performance, not merely worsen
training performance or replace A/P swaps with background errors. Seed-0
findings remain exploratory. Next round should combine successful changes and
confirm the selected configuration against its control on additional seeds,
then another fold; no result-dependent third run is silently included here.
